column3: To smoke, more formal and common in signs, health warnings and notices: 吸烟有害健康 "smoking harms your health", 禁止吸烟. In speech people say 抽烟. 吸 is "to inhale" and has 口 "mouth".
column6: Xīyān duì shēntǐ bù hǎo.
column7: Smoking is bad for your health.
column9: To smoke, more formal and common in signs, health warnings and notices: 吸煙有害健康 "smoking harms your health", 禁止吸煙. In speech people say 抽煙. 吸 is "to inhale" and has 口 "mouth".

column3: A "diary": 写日记 "write a diary", 一本日记. 日 is "day" and 记 "to record", so a record of days. The 讠 on the left is the speech radical, since to record is to put words down.
column6: Wǒ měitiān wǎnshang xiě rìjì.
column7: I write in my diary every evening.
column9: A "diary": 寫日記 "write a diary", 一本日記. 日 is "day" and 記 "to record", so a record of days. The 言 on the left is the speech radical, since to record is to put words down.

column3: A "calendar" showing days: 看日历, 一本日历, 手机日历. 日 is "day" and 历 means "calendar". For the year as a whole people also say 年历. A wall calendar is 挂历.
column4: 日历上写着今天是五号。
column5: 日曆上寫著今天是五號。
column6: Rìlì shàng xiězhe jīntiān shì wǔ hào.
column7: The calendar says today is the fifth.
column9: A "calendar" showing days: 看日曆, 一本日曆, 手機日曆. 日 is "day" and 曆 means "calendar". For the year as a whole people also say 年曆. A wall calendar is 掛曆.

column3: To relax, loosen up: 放松一下, 放松心情, 放松肌肉. It is something you do on purpose to unwind. 放 means "to let go" and 松 "loose", so you let yourself go loose.
column6: Zhōumò wǒ xiǎng fàngsōng yīxià.
column7: At the weekend I want to relax a bit.
column9: To relax, loosen up: 放鬆一下, 放鬆心情, 放鬆肌肉. It is something you do on purpose to unwind. 放 means "to let go" and 鬆 "loose", so you let yourself go loose.

column3: Comfortable, cozy, about physical comfort of a seat, bed, room or climate: 舒适的环境 "a comfortable setting", 很舒适. It describes things you feel comfortable in. 舒 means "stretch out" and 适 "suitable".
column6: Zhè zhāng shāfā hěn shūshì.
column7: This sofa is very comfortable.
column9: Comfortable, cozy, about physical comfort of a seat, bed, room or climate: 舒適的環境 "a comfortable setting", 很舒適. It describes things you feel comfortable in. 舒 means "stretch out" and 適 "suitable".

column3: Relaxed, easy: 轻松的工作 "an easy job", 感觉轻松, 轻轻松松 for emphasis. It describes tasks that take little effort, or a feeling free of worry. As a verb "to relax" is 放松. 轻 is "light" and 松 "loose".
column6: Zhè cì kǎoshì hěn qīngsōng.
column7: This exam was easy.
column9: Relaxed, easy: 輕鬆的工作 "an easy job", 感覺輕鬆, 輕輕鬆鬆 for emphasis. It describes tasks that take little effort, or a feeling free of worry. As a verb "to relax" is 放鬆. 輕 is "light" and 鬆 "loose".

column3: To form, acquire a habit: 养成习惯 "form a habit", 养成好习惯. The word is nearly always used with 习惯 or a similar thing. 养 means "to raise, nurture" and 成 "to become", so a habit is raised until it grows.
column6: Tā yǎngchéng le zǎoqǐ de xíguàn.
column7: He has got into the habit of getting up early.
column9: To form, acquire a habit: 養成習慣 "form a habit", 養成好習慣. The word is nearly always used with 習慣 or a similar thing. 養 means "to raise, nurture" and 成 "to become", so a habit is raised until it grows.

column3: An "insect, bug, worm": 一只虫子, 小虫子. It is the plain spoken word for any small creepy-crawly. The character 虫 is also a radical in the names of many insects and animals, like 蚂蚁 and 蜜蜂.
column6: Huā shàng yǒu yī zhī xiǎo chóngzi.
column7: There is a little bug on the flower.
column9: An "insect, bug, worm": 一隻蟲子, 小蟲子. It is the plain spoken word for any small creepy-crawly. The character 蟲 is also a radical in the names of many insects and animals, like 螞蟻 and 蜜蜂.

column3: A "tail": 摇尾巴 "wag the tail", 一条尾巴. The word is pronounced wěiba, with a neutral 巴. 尾 is a body 尸 with a hair 毛 hanging behind, which is easy to remember.
column6: Xiǎogǒu yáozhe wěiba.
column7: The puppy is wagging its tail.
column9: A "tail": 搖尾巴 "wag the tail", 一條尾巴. The word is pronounced wěiba, with a neutral 巴. 尾 is a body 尸 with a hair 毛 hanging behind, which is easy to remember.

column3: Woods, grove: a small stand of trees, smaller than a 森林. 树林里, 一片树林. 树 is "tree" and 林 is "woods", made of two 木 side by side.
column6: Wǒmen zài shùlín lǐ sànbù.
column7: We are walking in the woods.
column9: Woods, grove: a small stand of trees, smaller than a 森林. 樹林裡, 一片樹林. 樹 is "tree" and 林 is "woods", made of two 木 side by side.

column3: Leaves of a tree: 一片树叶, 秋天的树叶. 树叶 stresses leaves on or fallen from a tree, while 叶子 is the general word for a leaf of any plant. A leaf is counted by 片.
column6: Qiūtiān, shùyè dōu huáng le.
column7: In autumn the leaves have all turned yellow.
column9: Leaves of a tree: 一片樹葉, 秋天的樹葉. 樹葉 stresses leaves on or fallen from a tree, while 葉子 is the general word for a leaf of any plant. A leaf is counted by 片.

column3: A "leaf": 一片叶子, 叶子黄了. This is the general spoken word for any plant's leaf. In slang, 叶子 can mean marijuana.
column6: Zhè kē shù de yèzi hěn dà.
column7: This tree's leaves are very big.
column9: A "leaf": 一片葉子, 葉子黃了. This is the general spoken word for any plant's leaf. In slang, 葉子 can mean marijuana.

column3: Two words are both read sōng: "loose", as in 放松 and 这根绳子太松了, and  "pine", as in 松树. For "loose", the opposite is 紧. The pine's 木 "tree" sits beside 公, which gives the sound.
column6: Zhè gēn shéngzi tài sōng le.
column7: This rope is too loose.
column9: Two words are both read sōng: "loose", as in 放鬆 and 這根繩子太鬆了, and  "pine", as in 松樹. For "loose", the opposite is 緊. The pine's 木 "tree" sits beside 公, which gives the sound.

column3: A "pine tree": 一棵松树, 松树林. It stays green in winter, so it stands for strength in poems and paintings. 松 is the pine and 树 the tree.
column6: Shān shàng yǒu hěn duō sōngshù.
column7: There are many pine trees on the mountain.
column9: A "pine tree": 一棵松樹, 松樹林. It stays green in winter, so it stands for strength in poems and paintings. 松 is the pine and 樹 the tree.

column3: A "forest": 一片森林, 热带雨林 is a rain forest, and 保护森林 "protect forests". It is bigger and denser than a 树林. 森 is three 木 and 林 is two, so the word has five trees in it.
column6: Zhè zuò shān shàng yǒu dà piàn sēnlín.
column7: This mountain has a large forest.
column9: A "forest": 一片森林, 熱帶雨林 is a rain forest, and 保護森林 "protect forests". It is bigger and denser than a 樹林. 森 is three 木 and 林 is two, so the word has five trees in it.

column3: Plant, the living kind: 植物园 "botanical garden", 植物油 "vegetable oil". The pair of 动物 "animal". 植 has 木 "tree" and 直 for the sound, and means "to plant". 物 is "thing".
column6: Zhè zhǒng zhíwù xūyào hěn duō shuǐ.
column7: This plant needs a lot of water.
column9: Plant, the living kind: 植物園 "botanical garden", 植物油 "vegetable oil". The pair of 動物 "animal". 植 has 木 "tree" and 直 for the sound, and means "to plant". 物 is "thing".

column3: To plant, grow, cultivate crops and trees, in a formal and farming sense: 种植蔬菜, 种植园 "plantation". In speech 种 alone is more common. 种 is read zhòng when it is a verb. Both characters mean "plant", so it doubles up.
column6: Zhèlǐ zhǔyào zhòngzhí cháyè.
column7: Mainly tea is grown here.
column9: To plant, grow, cultivate crops and trees, in a formal and farming sense: 種植蔬菜, 種植園 "plantation". In speech 種 alone is more common. 種 is read zhòng when it is a verb. Both characters mean "plant", so it doubles up.

column3: To plant, to grow a plant or crop: 种花 "grow flowers", 种树 "plant a tree", 种菜 "grow vegetables". Read zhòng in this sense. The same character read zhǒng means "kind, type" and "seed" (这种, 种子). 禾 is "grain", with 中 for the sound.
column6: Yéye zài yuànzi lǐ zhòng huā.
column7: Grandpa grows flowers in the yard.
column9: To plant, to grow a plant or crop: 種花 "grow flowers", 種樹 "plant a tree", 種菜 "grow vegetables". Read zhòng in this sense. The same character read zhǒng means "kind, type" and "seed" (這種, 種子). 禾 is "grain", with 重 for the sound.

column3: To bloom, flower: 树开花了, 花开了. The verb is 开 "open", so a flower is said to "open". Figuratively "to blossom": 开花结果 "bear fruit", which is also used for success.
column6: Chūntiān, shù shàng kāihuā le.
column7: In spring the trees are in blossom.
column9: To bloom, flower: 樹開花了, 花開了. The verb is 開 "open", so a flower is said to "open". Figuratively "to blossom": 開花結果 "bear fruit", which is also used for success.

column3: Fresh flowers, cut and real ones, in a bunch: 一束鲜花 "a bouquet", 送鲜花. Paper or plastic flowers are 假花. 鲜 is "fresh" and 花 "flower". 花 has 艹 "plant" over 化, which gives the sound.
column6: Tā sònggěi tā yī shù xiānhuā.
column7: He gave her a bouquet of fresh flowers.
column9: Fresh flowers, cut and real ones, in a bunch: 一束鮮花 "a bouquet", 送鮮花. Paper or plastic flowers are 假花. 鮮 is "fresh" and 花 "flower". 花 has 艹 "plant" over 化, which gives the sound.

column3: A large "river", especially in the south: 长江 "the Yangtze", 珠江 "the Pearl River", 江边 "riverside". 河 is the usual word for a river in the north, 江 for a bigger one in the south. 氵 "water" is the meaning part and 工 the sound.
column6: Zhè tiáo jiāng hěn kuān.
column7: This river is very wide.
column9: A large "river", especially in the south: 長江 "the Yangtze", 珠江 "the Pearl River", 江邊 "riverside". 河 is the usual word for a river in the north, 江 for a bigger one in the south. 氵 "water" is the meaning part and 工 the sound.

column3: Dry land, as against the sea or air: 陆地和海洋, 回到陆地. 陆 is "land" and 地 "ground". A mainland is 大陆.
column6: Dìqiú shàng lùdì bǐ hǎiyáng xiǎo.
column7: There is less land than ocean on Earth.
column9: Dry land, as against the sea or air: 陸地和海洋, 回到陸地. 陸 is "land" and 地 "ground". A mainland is 大陸.

column3: Seawater: 海水又咸又苦 "salty and bitter". 海 is the sea and 水 water. It has 氵 "water" and 每, which gives the sound.
column6: Hǎishuǐ yòu xián yòu kǔ.
column7: Seawater is salty and bitter.
column9: Seawater: 海水又鹹又苦 "salty and bitter". 海 is the sea and 水 water. It has 氵 "water" and 每, which gives the sound.

column3: Land, soil, territory: 一块土地, 土地面积 "land area", 土地很肥沃. It is land as a resource for farming or building. 土 is a mound of earth and 地 "ground".
column4: 农民需要土地来种粮食。
column5: 農民需要土地來種糧食。
column6: Nóngmín xūyào tǔdì lái zhòng liángshi.
column7: Farmers need land to grow grain.
column9: Land, soil, territory: 一塊土地, 土地面積 "land area", 土地很肥沃. It is land as a resource for farming or building. 土 is a mound of earth and 地 "ground".

column3: A "shadow": 我的影子, 树的影子. It is the dark shape that something casts. It can also mean a faint trace or hint: 没有一点影子. 影 has 彡, which stands for light, and 景 for the sound.
column6: Tàiyáng xià, wǒ de yǐngzi hěn cháng.
column7: In the sun my shadow is long.
column9: A "shadow": 我的影子, 樹的影子. It is the dark shape that something casts. It can also mean a faint trace or hint: 沒有一點影子. 影 has 彡, which stands for light, and 景 for the sound.

column3: Spring as a season in a more formal, official way: 春季学期 "spring semester", 春季运动会. Everyday speech uses 春天. 季 is a "season" and has 禾 "grain" over 子 "child", a picture of a grain and a child.
column6: Chūnjì shì lǚyóu de hǎo shíhou.
column7: Spring is a good time to travel.
column9: Spring as a season in a more formal, official way: 春季學期 "spring semester", 春季運動會. Everyday speech uses 春天. 季 is a "season" and has 禾 "grain" over 子 "child", a picture of a grain and a child.

column3: Summer as a season, formal or in a report: 夏季风, 夏季天气. People say 夏天 in speech. It is used in forecasts, tourism and sales: 夏季大减价.
column6: Xiàjì chángcháng xià dàyǔ.
column7: It often rains hard in summer.
column9: Summer as a season, formal or in a report: 夏季風, 夏季天氣. People say 夏天 in speech. It is used in forecasts, tourism and sales: 夏季大減價.

column3: Autumn as a season, formal: 秋季学期, 秋季开学. Everyday speech uses 秋天. In 秋, 禾 "grain" sits beside 火 "fire", a picture of grain harvest, when the stubble was burnt.
column6: Xuéxiào qiūjì kāixué.
column7: School starts in the autumn.
column9: Autumn as a season, formal: 秋季學期, 秋季開學. Everyday speech uses 秋天. In 秋, 禾 "grain" sits beside 火 "fire", a picture of grain harvest, when the stubble was burnt.

column3: Winter as a season, formal: 冬季运动, 冬季奥运会 "the Winter Olympics", 冬季寒冷. Everyday speech uses 冬天. 冬 has 冫 "ice" under 夂, a man walking on ice.
column6: Běifāng de dōngjì hěn cháng.
column7: Winters in the north are long.
column9: Winter as a season, formal: 冬季運動, 冬季奧運會 "the Winter Olympics", 冬季寒冷. Everyday speech uses 冬天. 冬 has 冫 "ice" under 夂, a man walking on ice.

column3: A "season", found mostly in compounds: 四季 "four seasons", 雨季 "rainy season", 旺季 "peak season", 淡季 "off season", and in 春季, 夏季. It can also be a quarter of a year. The top 禾 is grain and the bottom 子 is a child or seed.
column6: Zhèlǐ de yǔjì hěn cháng.
column7: The rainy season here is long.
column9: A "season", found mostly in compounds: 四季 "four seasons", 雨季 "rainy season", 旺季 "peak season", 淡季 "off season", and in 春季, 夏季. It can also be a quarter of a year. The top 禾 is grain and the bottom 子 is a child or seed.

column3: Season: 四个季节, 季节变化 "seasonal change", 哪个季节. It means the time of year as a period, not the weather. 节 is "section" or "festival", and here "a section of the year".
column6: Nǐ zuì xǐhuan nǎge jìjié?
column7: Which season do you like best?
column9: Season: 四個季節, 季節變化 "seasonal change", 哪個季節. It means the time of year as a period, not the weather. 節 is "section" or "festival", and here "a section of the year".

column3: Cold, in a formal or written way, for weather or climate: 寒冷的冬天, 天气寒冷. It is colder than 冷. 寒 is "cold, chill" and 冷 "cold". 冷 has 冫 "ice" and 令 for the sound. Typical use: 气候寒冷.
column6: Běifāng de dōngtiān fēicháng hánlěng.
column7: Winter in the north is very cold.
column9: Cold, in a formal or written way, for weather or climate: 寒冷的冬天, 天氣寒冷. It is colder than 冷. 寒 is "cold, chill" and 冷 "cold". 冷 has 冫 "ice" and 令 for the sound. Typical use: 氣候寒冷.

column3: Damp, humid: 天气潮湿, 潮湿的房间, 衣服潮湿. It is used for air, rooms, walls or clothes that hold moisture, in a way you don't like. 潮 is "tide" and 湿 "wet".
column6: Nánfāng de tiānqì hěn cháoshī.
column7: The weather in the south is very damp.
column9: Damp, humid: 天氣潮濕, 潮濕的房間, 衣服潮濕. It is used for air, rooms, walls or clothes that hold moisture, in a way you don't like. 潮 is "tide" and 濕 "wet".

column3: Wet: 衣服湿了 "the clothes are wet", 湿透了 "soaked", 湿度 "humidity". The opposite is 干.
column4: 下雨了，我的衣服都湿了。
column5: 下雨了，我的衣服都濕了。
column6: Xià yǔ le, wǒ de yīfu dōu shī le.
column7: It rained and my clothes are all wet.
column9: Wet: 衣服溼了 "the clothes are wet", 溼透了 "soaked", 溼度 "humidity". The opposite is 乾.

column3: As a verb "to flash": 闪了一下 "flashed once", 闪光 "a flash", and "to dodge, jump aside": 闪开 "get out of the way". Lightning is 闪电. The character shows a person 人 glimpsed through a door 门, something that appears for a moment.
column6: Tiānkōng shǎn le yīxià.
column7: The sky flashed.
column9: As a verb "to flash": 閃了一下 "flashed once", 閃光 "a flash", and "to dodge, jump aside": 閃開 "get out of the way". Lightning is 閃電. The character shows a person 人 glimpsed through a door 門, something that appears for a moment.

column3: Lightning: 一道闪电 "a flash of lightning", 闪电划过夜空. It follows 打雷 "thunder" in storms: 又打雷又闪电. 闪 is "flash" and 电 "electricity", the same 电 as in 电话.
column6: Wǒ kànjiàn yī dào shǎndiàn.
column7: I saw a flash of lightning.
column9: Lightning: 一道閃電 "a flash of lightning", 閃電劃過夜空. It follows 打雷 "thunder" in storms: 又打雷又閃電. 閃 is "flash" and 電 "electricity", the same 電 as in 電話.

column3: To thunder: 打雷了, 打雷下雨. 打 is used as with other weather and events. Thunder is the rumble; lightning is 闪电. 雷 shows 雨 "rain" over 田 "field". Verb-object: 打了一个雷 "there was a clap of thunder".
column6: Wàimiàn zài dǎléi, nǐ pà ma?
column7: It's thundering outside, are you afraid?
column9: To thunder: 打雷了, 打雷下雨. 打 is used as with other weather and events. Thunder is the rumble; lightning is 閃電. 雷 shows 雨 "rain" over 田 "field". Verb-object: 打了一個雷 "there was a clap of thunder".

column3: The temperature drops or "to cool down": 明天降温 "it gets cooler tomorrow", 大幅降温. It is a regular word in forecasts, usually with a warning to wear more. 降 "fall, lower" is read jiàng here. 温 is "warm" or "temperature".
column4: 明天会降温，多穿点儿衣服。
column5: 明天會降溫，多穿點兒衣服。
column6: Míngtiān huì jiàngwēn, duō chuān diǎnr yīfu.
column7: It will get colder tomorrow, so wear more clothes.
column9: The temperature drops or "to cool down": 明天降溫 "it gets cooler tomorrow", 大幅降溫. It is a regular word in forecasts, usually with a warning to wear more. 降 "fall, lower" is read jiàng here. 溫 is "warm" or "temperature".

column3: Ice and snow: 冰雪运动 "winter sports", 冰雪覆盖 "covered in ice and snow". It is a written word for a landscape or winter themes, and also a symbol of purity. Both characters are weather forms of water: 冰 "ice" and 雪 "snow".
column6: Shān shàng de bīngxuě kāishǐ huà le.
column7: The ice and snow on the mountain are starting to melt.
column9: Ice and snow: 冰雪運動 "winter sports", 冰雪覆蓋 "covered in ice and snow". It is a written word for a landscape or winter themes, and also a symbol of purity. Both characters are weather forms of water: 冰 "ice" and 雪 "snow".

column3: To bask in the sun, "to dry in the sun": 晒太阳 "sunbathe", 晒衣服 "dry clothes in the sun". Also "to sunburn": 晒黑了. In online use "to show off, share" photos: 晒照片.
column6: Tāmen zài yángtái shàng shài yīfu.
column7: They are drying clothes on the balcony.
column9: To bask in the sun, "to dry in the sun": 曬太陽 "sunbathe", 曬衣服 "dry clothes in the sun". Also "to sunburn": 曬黑了. In online use "to show off, share" photos: 曬照片.

column3: Dark, of a place or a color: 房间很暗, 天暗了 "it has got dark", 暗红色 "dark red". Also "secret, hidden": 暗中 "in secret". It is the opposite of 亮. 日 "sun" is the meaning part, with 音 for the sound.
column6: Fángjiān lǐ tài àn le, kāidēng ba.
column7: It's too dark in the room, let's turn on the light.
column9: Dark, of a place or a color: 房間很暗, 天暗了 "it has got dark", 暗紅色 "dark red". Also "secret, hidden": 暗中 "in secret". It is the opposite of 亮. 日 "sun" is the meaning part, with 音 for the sound.

column3: Darkness, dark in the sense of no light: 黑暗的房间, 走出黑暗. It also means moral darkness, corrupt or cruel conditions: 黑暗的社会. An apostrophe separates the syllables. 黑 and 暗 both mean dark. 黑 has 灬 "fire" at the bottom, for the soot of a fire.
column6: Tā pà hēi'àn.
column7: He is afraid of the dark.
column9: Darkness, dark in the sense of no light: 黑暗的房間, 走出黑暗. It also means moral darkness, corrupt or cruel conditions: 黑暗的社會. An apostrophe separates the syllables. 黑 and 暗 both mean dark. 黑 has 灬 "fire" at the bottom, for the soot of a fire.

column3: As a verb "to pass through, to let through": 阳光透进来 "the sunlight comes through", 透气 "let air in". It also adds "thoroughly" after a verb or adjective: 湿透, 看透, 熟透 "fully ripe". 透 has 辶 "walk" on the left, as if passing through.
column6: Yángguāng cóng chuānghu tòu jìnlái.
column7: Sunlight comes through the window.
column9: As a verb "to pass through, to let through": 陽光透進來 "the sunlight comes through", 透氣 "let air in". It also adds "thoroughly" after a verb or adjective: 濕透, 看透, 熟透 "fully ripe". 透 has 辶 "walk" on the left, as if passing through.

column3: Bus, a loanword from English: 坐巴士. It is the usual word in Hong Kong and Singapore; in Taiwan a city bus is 公车. On the mainland, 公共汽车 or 公交车 is used for city buses, and 大巴 for coaches. Both 巴 and 士 are used only for their sounds.
column6: Wǒmen zuò bāshì qù jīchǎng.
column7: We take the bus to the airport.
column9: Bus, a loanword from English: 坐巴士. It is the usual word in Hong Kong and Singapore; in Taiwan a city bus is 公車. On the mainland, 公共汽車 or 公交車 is used for city buses, and 大巴 for coaches. Both 巴 and 士 are used only for their sounds.

column3: A "coach", a large bus used for tours and trips between towns: 坐大巴, 旅游大巴. It comes from 大型巴士 "large bus". City buses are 公交车. In speech 大巴 is the common word for a long-distance or tour bus.
column6: Wǒmen zuò dàbā qù lǚyóu.
column7: We take a coach on our trip.
column9: A "coach", a large bus used for tours and trips between towns: 坐大巴, 旅遊大巴. It comes from 大型巴士 "large bus". City buses are 公交車. In speech 大巴 is the common word for a long-distance or tour bus.

column3: High-speed rail: 坐高铁, 高铁站. It is short for 高速铁路. 铁 means iron.
column4: 坐高铁去北京只要四个小时。
column5: 坐高鐵去北京只要四個小時。
column6: Zuò gāotiě qù Běijīng zhǐyào sì ge xiǎoshí.
column7: By high-speed train it takes only four hours to get to Beijing.
column9: High-speed rail: 坐高鐵, 高鐵站. It is short for 高速鐵路. 鐵 means iron.

column3: A "scheduled flight": 航班号 "flight number", 航班延误 "flight delay", 乘坐这个航班. 航 means "to sail, to fly" and 班 "a scheduled run". It names the service by number, not the aircraft; the plane is 飞机.
column6: Zhège hángbān wǎndiǎn le.
column7: This flight is delayed.
column9: A "scheduled flight": 航班號 "flight number", 航班延誤 "flight delay", 乘坐這個航班. 航 means "to sail, to fly" and 班 "a scheduled run". It names the service by number, not the aircraft; the plane is 飛機.

column3: Aviation, air: it is found in 航空公司 "airline", 航空邮件 "airmail", 中国国际航空. It is rarely used alone. 航 is "navigate" and 空 "air".
column4: 这家航空公司的服务很好。
column5: 這家航空公司的服務很好。
column6: Zhè jiā hángkōng gōngsī de fúwù hěn hǎo.
column7: This airline's service is very good.
column9: Aviation, air: it is found in 航空公司 "airline", 航空郵件 "airmail", 中國國際航空. It is rarely used alone. 航 is "navigate" and 空 "air".

column3: A "steamer, ship" driven by an engine, as opposed to a sailing boat: 坐轮船. It is a bit old-fashioned; today ships are called just 船, and a cruise ship is 游轮. 轮 is "wheel" (the paddle wheel of early steamships) and 船 "boat".
column6: Wǒmen zuò lúnchuán guò jiāng.
column7: We take a ferry across the river.
column9: A "steamer, ship" driven by an engine, as opposed to a sailing boat: 坐輪船. It is a bit old-fashioned; today ships are called just 船, and a cruise ship is 遊輪. 輪 is "wheel" (the paddle wheel of early steamships) and 船 "boat".

column3: A "wheel": 四个轮子, 轮子坏了. It is the spoken word for the thing that rolls on a car, suitcase or chair. 轮 has 车 "cart" on the left, since it is a part of a cart. 子 is neutral.
column6: Zhè liàng chē yǒu sì ge lúnzi.
column7: This car has four wheels.
column9: A "wheel": 四個輪子, 輪子壞了. It is the spoken word for the thing that rolls on a car, suitcase or chair. 輪 has 車 "cart" on the left, since it is a part of a cart. 子 is neutral.

column3: A "wheelchair": 坐轮椅, 一把轮椅. 轮 is "wheel" and 椅 "chair"; 椅 has 木 "wood". The word for chair on its own is 椅子.
column6: Tā zuò lúnyǐ chūmén.
column7: He goes out in a wheelchair.
column9: A "wheelchair": 坐輪椅, 一把輪椅. 輪 is "wheel" and 椅 "chair"; 椅 has 木 "wood". The word for chair on its own is 椅子.

column3: A "train" in a formal or official sense: 高速列车, 列车员 "train attendant", 列车到站. The usual spoken word is 火车. 列 is "row, line" and 车 "vehicle", a line of cars.
column6: Lièchē mǎshàng jiù yào chūfā le.
column7: The train is about to leave.
column9: A "train" in a formal or official sense: 高速列車, 列車員 "train attendant", 列車到站. The usual spoken word is 火車. 列 is "row, line" and 車 "vehicle", a line of cars.

column3: An "electric vehicle", most often an electric bike or scooter in daily life in China: 骑电动车, 电动车充电. In news it is also used for electric cars, which are more precisely 电动汽车 or 新能源汽车. 电 is "electric", 动 "move" and 车 "vehicle".
column6: Tā měitiān qí diàndòngchē shàngbān.
column7: He rides an electric scooter to work every day.
column9: An "electric vehicle", most often an electric bike or scooter in daily life in China: 騎電動車, 電動車充電. In news it is also used for electric cars, which are more precisely 電動汽車 or 新能源汽車. 電 is "electric", 動 "move" and 車 "vehicle".

column3: Here read dǎochē, "to change buses or trains": 在这儿倒车 "change here", 倒两次车. The same characters read dào chē mean "to reverse" (the next entry). The reading depends on the meaning: 倒 is dǎo "fall, change" or dào "backward".
column4: 在这儿倒车，然后坐三号线。
column5: 在這兒倒車，然後坐三號線。
column6: Zài zhèr dǎochē, ránhòu zuò sān hào xiàn.
column7: Change here, then take line three.
column9: Here read dǎochē, "to change buses or trains": 在這兒倒車 "change here", 倒兩次車. The same characters read dào chē mean "to reverse" (the next entry). The reading depends on the meaning: 倒 is dǎo "fall, change" or dào "backward".

column3: Here read dàochē, "to reverse" a car: 倒车入库 "reverse into the garage", 倒车影像 "reversing camera". The same characters read dǎochē mean "to change buses". 倒 is dào when it means "backward".
column6: Dàochē de shíhou yào xiǎoxīn.
column7: Be careful when you reverse.
column9: Here read dàochē, "to reverse" a car: 倒車入庫 "reverse into the garage", 倒車影像 "reversing camera". The same characters read dǎochē mean "to change buses". 倒 is dào when it means "backward".

column3: To block, stop up a road, a pipe, a hole: 堵住, 路堵了 "the road is blocked", 下水道堵了. It is also "stuffed up" in feelings: 心里堵得慌. 土 "earth" is at the left, as walls were of earth, and 者 gives the sound.
column6: Qiánmiàn de lù dǔ le.
column7: The road ahead is blocked.
column9: To block, stop up a road, a pipe, a hole: 堵住, 路堵了 "the road is blocked", 下水道堵了. It is also "stuffed up" in feelings: 心裡堵得慌. 土 "earth" is at the left, as walls were of earth, and 者 gives the sound.

column3: Traffic jam; to be stuck in traffic: 堵车了, 路上堵车, 严重堵车. A verb and its object, so say 堵了两个小时的车 for the length. It is a frequent excuse for being late: 路上堵车了. 堵 "block" plus 车 "vehicle".
column6: Jīntiān zǎoshang lùshang dǔchē le.
column7: There was a traffic jam on the road this morning.
column9: Traffic jam; to be stuck in traffic: 堵車了, 路上堵車, 嚴重堵車. A verb and its object, so say 堵了兩個小時的車 for the length. It is a frequent excuse for being late: 路上堵車了. 堵 "block" plus 車 "vehicle".

column3: A "gas station": 去加油站, 加油站在哪里？ 加油 is "to add fuel", and also "keep it up!" as a cheer; 站 is a "station" or "stop". 站 has 立 "stand" and 占 for the sound.
column6: Qiánmiàn yǒu yī ge jiāyóuzhàn.
column7: There is a gas station ahead.
column9: A "gas station": 去加油站, 加油站在哪裡？ 加油 is "to add fuel", and also "keep it up!" as a cheer; 站 is a "station" or "stop". 站 has 立 "stand" and 占 for the sound.

column3: To land of aircraft, or to descend: 飞机降落, 安全降落, 降落伞 "parachute". The opposite is 起飞. Both characters mean "to fall", so a plane comes down. 降 is read jiàng.
column4: 飞机将在十分钟后降落。
column5: 飛機將在十分鐘後降落。
column6: Fēijī jiāng zài shí fēnzhōng hòu jiàngluò.
column7: The plane will land in ten minutes.
column9: To land of aircraft, or to descend: 飛機降落, 安全降落, 降落傘 "parachute". The opposite is 起飛. Both characters mean "to fall", so a plane comes down. 降 is read jiàng.

column3: To go on foot: 步行十分钟, 步行街 "pedestrian street". It stresses walking as the way to get somewhere, with 走路 the everyday word. 步 is a "step", a foot 止 in front of another, and 行 is read xíng here.
column4: 从这里步行到学校要二十分钟。
column5: 從這裡步行到學校要二十分鐘。
column6: Cóng zhèlǐ bùxíng dào xuéxiào yào èrshí fēnzhōng.
column7: It takes twenty minutes to walk from here to the school.
column9: To go on foot: 步行十分鐘, 步行街 "pedestrian street". It stresses walking as the way to get somewhere, with 走路 the everyday word. 步 is a "step", a foot 止 in front of another, and 行 is read xíng here.

column3: Long-distance: 长途汽车, 长途电话, 长途旅行, 长途飞行. It is always put before a noun. The opposite is 短途. 长 is read cháng, "long". 途 means "road" and has 辶 "walk".
column6: Wǒ bù xǐhuan zuò chángtú qìchē.
column7: I don't like taking long-distance buses.
column9: Long-distance: 長途汽車, 長途電話, 長途旅行, 長途飛行. It is always put before a noun. The opposite is 短途. 長 is read cháng, "long". 途 means "road" and has 辶 "walk".

column3: To stop, come to a halt: 停下来 "stop", 车停下了. 下 shows the movement ending. It is a result complement: the thing was moving and now isn't. For "to park" use 停. 停 has 亻 "person" and 亭 for the sound.
column6: Chē tūrán tíngxià le.
column7: The car suddenly stopped.
column9: To stop, come to a halt: 停下來 "stop", 車停下了. 下 shows the movement ending. It is a result complement: the thing was moving and now isn't. For "to park" use 停. 停 has 亻 "person" and 亭 for the sound.

column3: To bend, "bent": 弯腰 "bend over", 弯路 "a detour, a wrong path", 这条路很弯. As a noun "a bend": 转弯. 弯 has 弓 "bow" at the bottom, a bending object.
column6: Zhè tiáo lù yǒu hěn duō wān.
column7: This road has many bends.
column9: To bend, "bent": 彎腰 "bend over", 彎路 "a detour, a wrong path", 這條路很彎. As a noun "a bend": 轉彎. 彎 has 弓 "bow" at the bottom, a bending object.

column3: To turn a corner in a vehicle or on foot: 向左转弯, 转弯的时候 "when turning". It is a verb and its object. 转 is read zhuǎn here, meaning "to turn"; 弯 is the bend. 转 has 车 "cart" and 专 for the sound.
column6: Qiánmiàn lùkǒu qǐng xiàng yòu zhuǎnwān.
column7: Please turn right at the next intersection.
column9: To turn a corner in a vehicle or on foot: 向左轉彎, 轉彎的時候 "when turning". It is a verb and its object. 轉 is read zhuǎn here, meaning "to turn"; 彎 is the bend. 轉 has 車 "cart" and 專 for the sound.

column3: A "street": 街道很干净, 这条街道. It is an ordinary street in a town, as against 马路 "road". Also an administrative "subdistrict": 街道办事处 is the lowest city office. 街 has 行 around 圭, a crossing; 道 has 辶 "walk" and 首.
column6: Zhè tiáo jiēdào hěn ānjìng.
column7: This street is very quiet.
column9: A "street": 街道很乾淨, 這條街道. It is an ordinary street in a town, as against 馬路 "road". Also an administrative "subdistrict": 街道辦事處 is the lowest city office. 街 has 行 around 圭, a crossing; 道 has 辶 "walk" and 首.

column3: The "city proper, downtown": 市区里, 离市区很远. The opposite is 郊区 "suburb". 市 is "city" and 区 "district".
column6: Wǒ jiā lí shìqū hěn yuǎn.
column7: My home is far from the city center.
column9: The "city proper, downtown": 市區裡, 離市區很遠. The opposite is 郊區 "suburb". 市 is "city" and 區 "district".

column3: A "county", an administrative unit below the city or prefecture: 县城 "county town", 县长 "county chief". A village belongs to a 乡 which belongs to a 县.
column6: Zhège xiàn yǒu wǔshí wàn rénkǒu.
column7: This county has five hundred thousand people.
column9: A "county", an administrative unit below the city or prefecture: 縣城 "county town", 縣長 "county chief". A village belongs to a 鄉 which belongs to a 縣.

column3: Continent or "the mainland": 中国大陆 "mainland China", 亚洲大陆. In Taiwan and Hong Kong 大陆 means mainland China, by contrast. People on the mainland speak of 内地 or 国内 for the same.
column6: Tā shì cóng Zhōngguó dàlù lái de.
column7: He is from mainland China.
column9: Continent or "the mainland": 中國大陸 "mainland China", 亞洲大陸. In Taiwan and Hong Kong 大陸 means mainland China, by contrast. People on the mainland speak of 內地 or 國內 for the same.

column3: An "address": 写地址, 你的地址是什么？ 电子邮件地址 is an email address, and 网址 a web address. 地 is "place" and 址 "site"; 址 has 土 "earth" and 止.
column4: 请把你的地址写在这里。
column5: 請把你的地址寫在這裡。
column6: Qǐng bǎ nǐ de dìzhǐ xiě zài zhèlǐ.
column7: Please write your address here.
column9: An "address": 寫地址, 你的地址是什麼？ 電子郵件地址 is an email address, and 網址 a web address. 地 is "place" and 址 "site"; 址 has 土 "earth" and 止.

column3: A "post office": 去邮局, 邮局寄信. 邮 means "mail" and 局 "bureau". At the post office you 寄信 "send a letter" or 寄包裹 "send a parcel".
column6: Wǒ yào qù yóujú jì xìn.
column7: I'm going to the post office to mail a letter.
column9: A "post office": 去郵局, 郵局寄信. 郵 means "mail" and 局 "bureau". At the post office you 寄信 "send a letter" or 寄包裹 "send a parcel".

column3: Express delivery, courier: 寄快递 "send by courier", 收快递, 取快递, 快递员 "courier". It goes with online shopping. 快 "fast" plus 递 "to hand over".
column6: Wǒ de kuàidì jīntiān dào le.
column7: My package arrived today.
column9: Express delivery, courier: 寄快遞 "send by courier", 收快遞, 取快遞, 快遞員 "courier". It goes with online shopping. 快 "fast" plus 遞 "to hand over".

column3: A "parcel, package": 一个包裹, 取包裹, 寄包裹. 快递 is the service, 包裹 the item. It is also a verb, "to wrap up": 包裹伤口 "bandage a wound". 包 is "wrap" and 裹 "wrap" too.
column6: Yóujú tōngzhī wǒ qù qǔ bāoguǒ.
column7: The post office told me to pick up a parcel.
column9: A "parcel, package": 一個包裹, 取包裹, 寄包裹. 快遞 is the service, 包裹 the item. It is also a verb, "to wrap up": 包裹傷口 "bandage a wound". 包 is "wrap" and 裹 "wrap" too.

column3: A school "playground, sports field": 操场上, 在操场跑步. A place for exercise, with 操 "drill, exercise" and 场 "field, place". 场 has 土 "earth".
column6: Xuéshengmen zài cāochǎng shàng pǎobù.
column7: The students are running on the sports field.
column9: A school "playground, sports field": 操場上, 在操場跑步. A place for exercise, with 操 "drill, exercise" and 場 "field, place". 場 has 土 "earth".

column3: General merchandise: it is found in 百货商店 or 百货公司 "department store", 日用百货 "daily goods". 百 is "hundred" and 货 "goods", so a hundred kinds of goods.
column4: 周末我们去百货商店买东西。
column5: 週末我們去百貨商店買東西。
column6: Zhōumò wǒmen qù bǎihuò shāngdiàn mǎi dōngxi.
column7: At the weekend we go to the department store to shop.
column9: General merchandise: it is found in 百貨商店 or 百貨公司 "department store", 日用百貨 "daily goods". 百 is "hundred" and 貨 "goods", so a hundred kinds of goods.

column3: To live, reside in a place, a formal or written word: 居住在上海 "live in Shanghai", 居住条件 "living conditions". In speech 住 is the common verb. 居 has 户 "door" over 古, and 住 has 亻 "person" and 主.
column6: Tā yīzhí jūzhù zài Shànghǎi.
column7: He has always lived in Shanghai.
column9: To live, reside in a place, a formal or written word: 居住在上海 "live in Shanghai", 居住條件 "living conditions". In speech 住 is the common verb. 居 has 戶 "door" over 古, and 住 has 亻 "person" and 主.

column3: To immigrate or emigrate, and the person: 移民到加拿大 "emigrate to Canada", 新移民 "new immigrants". It is both a verb and a noun, and covers both directions. 移 is "to move" and 民 "people". 移 has 禾 and 多, with 多 for the sound.
column4: 他们打算移民到加拿大。
column5: 他們打算移民到加拿大。
column6: Tāmen dǎsuàn yímín dào Jiānádà.
column7: They plan to emigrate to Canada.
column9: To immigrate or emigrate, and the person: 移民到加拿大 "emigrate to Canada", 新移民 "new immigrants". It is both a verb and a noun, and covers both directions. 移 is "to move" and 民 "people". 移 has 禾 and 多, with 多 for the sound.

column3: A "tour guide": 当导游, 请导游. Also a verb "to guide a tour" and a guidebook. 导 is "to lead" and 游 "to tour"; 导 has a hand 寸 below 巳. The guide is who takes you around a site.
column4: 导游带我们参观了古城。
column5: 導遊帶我們參觀了古城。
column6: Dǎoyóu dài wǒmen cānguān le gǔchéng.
column7: The guide took us around the old town.
column9: A "tour guide": 當導遊, 請導遊. Also a verb "to guide a tour" and a guidebook. 導 is "to lead" and 遊 "to tour"; 導 has a hand 寸 below 道. The guide is who takes you around a site.

column3: To stroll, wander around, often among shops or sights, without a strict goal: 逛街 "go shopping, stroll the streets", 逛公园, 逛商店. It is a leisure activity. 辶 "walk" is the meaning part and 狂 the sound.
column6: Zhōumò wǒmen qù guàng jiē.
column7: At the weekend we go window-shopping.
column9: To stroll, wander around, often among shops or sights, without a strict goal: 逛街 "go shopping, stroll the streets", 逛公園, 逛商店. It is a leisure activity. 辶 "walk" is the meaning part and 狂 the sound.

column3: To climb, mount: 登山 "climb a mountain", 登上山顶 "reach the summit", 登长城. Also "to publish": 登报 "put in the newspaper", and "to log in": 登录. In 登 the 癶 on top shows two feet going up.
column6: Wǒmen míngtiān zǎoshang dēng Chángchéng.
column7: Tomorrow morning we are climbing the Great Wall.
column9: To climb, mount: 登山 "climb a mountain", 登上山頂 "reach the summit", 登長城. Also "to publish": 登報 "put in the newspaper", and "to log in": 登錄. In 登 the 癶 on top shows two feet going up.

column3: Mountain climbing, hiking up a mountain: 爱好登山, 登山者 "climber", 登山鞋 "hiking boots". It ranges from a day's walk to a serious climb. 登 is "climb" and 山 "mountain", a picture of three peaks.
column6: Tā de àihào shì dēngshān.
column7: His hobby is mountain climbing.
column9: Mountain climbing, hiking up a mountain: 愛好登山, 登山者 "climber", 登山鞋 "hiking boots". It ranges from a day's walk to a serious climb. 登 is "climb" and 山 "mountain", a picture of three peaks.

column3: Scenery, view: 风景很美, 欣赏风景 "enjoy the view", 风景区 "scenic area". It is what you look at, as of a landscape, a lake or a town. 风 is "wind", and 景 has 日 "sun" over 京.
column6: Zhèlǐ de fēngjǐng zhēn měi.
column7: The scenery here is really beautiful.
column9: Scenery, view: 風景很美, 欣賞風景 "enjoy the view", 風景區 "scenic area". It is what you look at, as of a landscape, a lake or a town. 風 is "wind", and 景 has 日 "sun" over 京.

column3: A local "custom", tradition of a place or a people: 当地的风俗, 风俗习惯 "customs and habits". It covers things like festivals, food and manners. 风 is "wind" and 俗 "common, custom"; 俗 has 亻 "person" and 谷.
column4: 每个地方的风俗都不一样。
column5: 每個地方的風俗都不一樣。
column6: Měi ge dìfang de fēngsú dōu bù yīyàng.
column7: Every place has different customs.
column9: A local "custom", tradition of a place or a people: 當地的風俗, 風俗習慣 "customs and habits". It covers things like festivals, food and manners. 風 is "wind" and 俗 "common, custom"; 俗 has 亻 "person" and 谷.

column3: To take a photo: 拍照片 or 拍张照 "take a photo", 帮我们拍照 "take a picture of us". 拍 is "to hit, to pat" and 照 "to shine on, a picture". A verb and its object, so 拍了很多照.
column6: Qǐng bāng wǒmen pāizhào.
column7: Please take a photo of us.
column9: To take a photo: 拍照片 or 拍張照 "take a photo", 幫我們拍照 "take a picture of us". 拍 is "to hit, to pat" and 照 "to shine on, a picture". A verb and its object, so 拍了很多照.

column3: A "camera lens" or a "shot" in a film: 看镜头 "look at the lens", 一个镜头 "a shot", 镜头前 "in front of the camera". 镜 is "mirror, lens", with 钅 "metal", and 头 is "head", but here a suffix.
column6: Qǐng kàn jìngtóu, xiào yī xiào.
column7: Look at the camera and smile.
column9: A "camera lens" or a "shot" in a film: 看鏡頭 "look at the lens", 一個鏡頭 "a shot", 鏡頭前 "in front of the camera". 鏡 is "mirror, lens", with 釒 "metal", and 頭 is "head", but here a suffix.

column3: A "photograph": 一张相片, 洗相片 "develop photos". 相 is read xiàng here, "appearance, picture", not xiāng. Taiwan uses 相片 a lot; on the mainland 照片 is more usual. 片 is a "piece, flat thing".
column6: Qiáng shàng guàzhe yī zhāng xiàngpiàn.
column7: A photograph is hanging on the wall.
column9: A "photograph": 一張相片, 洗相片 "develop photos". 相 is read xiàng here, "appearance, picture", not xiāng. Taiwan uses 相片 a lot; on the mainland 照片 is more usual. 片 is a "piece, flat thing".

column3: To book, reserve in advance: 预订酒店 "book a hotel", 预订机票, 提前预订. You can use it for tickets, rooms, tables, goods. 预 is "in advance" and 订 "to order".
column6: Wǒ yǐjīng yùdìng le jīpiào.
column7: I have already booked the flight.
column9: To book, reserve in advance: 預訂酒店 "book a hotel", 預訂機票, 提前預訂. You can use it for tickets, rooms, tables, goods. 預 is "in advance" and 訂 "to order".

column3: A polite word for "to honor with one's presence", used by shops and hotels: 欢迎光临 "welcome" is on shop doors. 光 "light, honor" and 临 "to arrive". It is a formal word for guests, never used of yourself.
column6: Huānyíng guānglín! Qǐngwèn jǐ wèi?
column7: Welcome! How many in your party?
column9: A polite word for "to honor with one's presence", used by shops and hotels: 歡迎光臨 "welcome" is on shop doors. 光 "light, honor" and 臨 "to arrive". It is a formal word for guests, never used of yourself.

column3: To spend, pass a stretch of time, often a happy one: 度过假期 "spend the vacation", 度过童年, 度过难关 "get through a difficulty". It is used for periods, not a moment. 度 is read dù, "to pass time", and 过 "to go through".
column4: 我们在海边度过了一个周末。
column5: 我們在海邊度過了一個週末。
column6: Wǒmen zài hǎibiān dùguò le yī ge zhōumò.
column7: We spent a weekend at the seaside.
column9: To spend, pass a stretch of time, often a happy one: 度過假期 "spend the vacation", 度過童年, 度過難關 "get through a difficulty". It is used for periods, not a moment. 度 is read dù, "to pass time", and 過 "to go through".

column3: On the way, en route: 在去机场的途中, 旅行途中. It sets what happens between two places. 途 is "road, way" and 中 "middle", a line through the center of a box.
column4: 在去机场的途中，我们遇到了堵车。
column5: 在去機場的途中，我們遇到了堵車。
column6: Zài qù jīchǎng de túzhōng, wǒmen yùdào le dǔchē.
column7: On the way to the airport we ran into a traffic jam.
column9: On the way, en route: 在去機場的途中, 旅行途中. It sets what happens between two places. 途 is "road, way" and 中 "middle", a line through the center of a box.

column3: A "scene, situation" that you see or remember: 想起当时的情景 "recall the scene at that time", 感人的情景 "a moving scene". It is a view with feelings, not just a landscape (that is 风景). 情 is "feeling" and 景 "view".
column4: 我还记得第一次见面的情景。
column5: 我還記得第一次見面的情景。
column6: Wǒ hái jìde dì yī cì jiànmiàn de qíngjǐng.
column7: I still remember the scene of our first meeting.
column9: A "scene, situation" that you see or remember: 想起當時的情景 "recall the scene at that time", 感人的情景 "a moving scene". It is a view with feelings, not just a landscape (that is 風景). 情 is "feeling" and 景 "view".

column3: To register, check in: 登记姓名 "register one's name", 登记入住 "check in", 结婚登记 "marriage registration". It means to put your name on a list, often at a counter. 登 "enter" and 记 "record".
column6: Qǐng zài zhèlǐ dēngjì yīxià.
column7: Please register here.
column9: To register, check in: 登記姓名 "register one's name", 登記入住 "check in", 結婚登記 "marriage registration". It means to put your name on a list, often at a counter. 登 "enter" and 記 "record".

column3: The end of the month: 月底前 "before the end of the month", 本月底. The start is 月初. 月 is a crescent moon and 底 "bottom". Commonly used with deadlines, rent or pay days.
column6: Wǒ yuèdǐ yào bānjiā.
column7: I'm moving at the end of the month.
column9: The end of the month: 月底前 "before the end of the month", 本月底. The start is 月初. 月 is a crescent moon and 底 "bottom". Commonly used with deadlines, rent or pay days.

column3: A "quarter" of the year, three months: 第一季度, 季度报告. Financial reporting and economic news use it. 季 is "season" and 度 a "unit of measure". Also the "season" in sports. In speech people say 三个月 for three months.
column4: 公司今年第一季度的收入增加了。
column5: 公司今年第一季度的收入增加了。
column6: Gōngsī jīnnián dì yī jìdù de shōurù zēngjiā le.
column7: The company's income rose in the first quarter this year.
column9: A "quarter" of the year, three months: 第一季度, 季度報告. Financial reporting and economic news use it. 季 is "season" and 度 a "unit of measure". Also the "season" in sports. In speech people say 三個月 for three months.

column3: Last month: 上个月 and 下个月 "next month" use 个 as a measure word between 上/下 and 月. Counting months always needs 个: 一个月 "one month". The same pattern gives 上个星期 "last week". It is a time word and goes before the verb.
column6: Wǒ shànggeyuè qù le Shànghǎi.
column7: I went to Shanghai last month.
column9: Last month: 上個月 and 下個月 "next month" use 個 as a measure word between 上/下 and 月. Counting months always needs 個: 一個月 "one month". The same pattern gives 上個星期 "last week". It is a time word and goes before the verb.

column3: Next month: 下个月 puts 个 between 下 "next" and 月 "month", like 上个月 "last month". It is a time word, so it goes before the verb or at the start: 下个月我要出差. For "this month" you say 这个月.
column6: Xiàgeyuè wǒ yào qù Běijīng.
column7: Next month I am going to Beijing.
column9: Next month: 下個月 puts 個 between 下 "next" and 月 "month", like 上個月 "last month". It is a time word, so it goes before the verb or at the start: 下個月我要出差. For "this month" you say 這個月.

column3: Many years: 多年来 "for many years", 多年的朋友 "old friend of many years", 多年前 "many years ago". It does not give an exact number but a long stretch. 多 means "many" and is two 夕 "evenings" in a row.
column6: Tā zài zhèlǐ gōngzuò le duōnián.
column7: He has worked here for many years.
column9: Many years: 多年來 "for many years", 多年的朋友 "old friend of many years", 多年前 "many years ago". It does not give an exact number but a long stretch. 多 means "many" and is two 夕 "evenings" in a row.

column3: Many times, repeatedly: 多次提醒 "remind many times", 去过多次. It goes before the verb or after the verb with 过. It is a more formal way than 很多次. 次 is a measure word for occasions.
column6: Wǒ qù guo nàlǐ duōcì.
column7: I have been there many times.
column9: Many times, repeatedly: 多次提醒 "remind many times", 去過多次. It goes before the verb or after the verb with 過. It is a more formal way than 很多次. 次 is a measure word for occasions.

column3: During, in the period of: 春节期间, 比赛期间, 学习期间. It follows the noun that gives the period, and refers to an event with a time span. It is not for a moment. 期 is a "period" and 间 "between"; the picture of 间 is the sun 日 shining through a door gap 门.
column4: 春节期间，很多商店不开门。
column5: 春節期間，很多商店不開門。
column6: Chūnjié qījiān, hěn duō shāngdiàn bù kāimén.
column7: During the Spring Festival many stores are closed.
column9: During, in the period of: 春節期間, 比賽期間, 學習期間. It follows the noun that gives the period, and refers to an event with a time span. It is not for a moment. 期 is a "period" and 間 "between"; the picture of 間 is the sun 日 shining through a door gap 門.

column3: A "deadline, time limit": 超过期限 "go past the deadline", 在期限内 "within the time limit", 没有期限 "no time limit". 期 "period" plus 限 "limit". The word is used for contracts, loans and homework.
column4: 这个作业的期限是周五。
column5: 這個作業的期限是週五。
column6: Zhège zuòyè de qīxiàn shì zhōuwǔ.
column7: The deadline for this homework is Friday.
column9: A "deadline, time limit": 超過期限 "go past the deadline", 在期限內 "within the time limit", 沒有期限 "no time limit". 期 "period" plus 限 "limit". The word is used for contracts, loans and homework.

column3: A "stage, phase": 第一阶段, 现阶段 "at the present stage", 不同的阶段. It describes a step in a process, a life or a project. 阶 has 阝 "hill", since steps go up a slope, and 段 is a "section".
column4: 这个项目已经进入第二阶段。
column5: 這個項目已經進入第二階段。
column6: Zhège xiàngmù yǐjīng jìnrù dì èr jiēduàn.
column7: This project has already entered its second stage.
column9: A "stage, phase": 第一階段, 現階段 "at the present stage", 不同的階段. It describes a step in a process, a life or a project. 階 has 阝 "hill", since steps go up a slope, and 段 is a "section".

column3: Nowadays, these days, with a note of contrast with the past: 如今，很多人… "nowadays many people…". It is written or fairly formal, and starts the sentence or goes before the verb. 如 "as" and 今 "now".
column4: 如今，很多人都用手机付钱。
column5: 如今，很多人都用手機付錢。
column6: Rújīn, hěn duō rén dōu yòng shǒujī fù qián.
column7: Nowadays many people pay with their phones.
column9: Nowadays, these days, with a note of contrast with the past: 如今，很多人… "nowadays many people…". It is written or fairly formal, and starts the sentence or goes before the verb. 如 "as" and 今 "now".

column3: The future: 未来的计划 "future plans", 美好的未来. It can also be "future" as a modifier: 未来几天 "the coming days". 未 is "not yet" and 来 "come", so "not yet come". The opposite is 过去.
column6: Nǐ duì wèilái yǒu shénme dǎsuàn?
column7: What are your plans for the future?
column9: The future: 未來的計劃 "future plans", 美好的未來. It can also be "future" as a modifier: 未來幾天 "the coming days". 未 is "not yet" and 來 "come", so "not yet come". The opposite is 過去.

column3: At first, initially, originally: 最初的想法 "the original idea", 最初，… "At first…". It marks the very start of a process. 最 is "most" and 初 "first". 初 has 衣 and 刀: cutting cloth, the first step in making clothes.
column4: 最初，我一句中文也不会说。
column5: 最初，我一句中文也不會說。
column6: Zuìchū, wǒ yī jù Zhōngwén yě bù huì shuō.
column7: At first I couldn't say a word of Chinese.
column9: At first, initially, originally: 最初的想法 "the original idea", 最初，… "At first…". It marks the very start of a process. 最 is "most" and 初 "first". 初 has 衣 and 刀: cutting cloth, the first step in making clothes.

column3: Before, prior to: 睡觉之前 "before going to bed", 三年之前 "three years before". It follows a noun or verb phrase. The opposite is 之后. In speech 以前 is equal, and 之前 is slightly more formal.
column6: Shuìjiào zhīqián, wǒ xǐhuan kàn shū.
column7: Before going to bed, I like to read.
column9: Before, prior to: 睡覺之前 "before going to bed", 三年之前 "three years before". It follows a noun or verb phrase. The opposite is 之後. In speech 以前 is equal, and 之前 is slightly more formal.

column3: After, afterwards: 下班之后 "after work", 三天之后 "three days later". It follows the phrase it modifies, and can also stand alone at the start: 之后，我们… "afterwards we…". The opposite is 之前. 之后 is a bit more formal than 以后.
column4: 下班之后，我们去吃饭吧。
column5: 下班之後，我們去吃飯吧。
column6: Xiàbān zhīhòu, wǒmen qù chīfàn ba.
column7: After work, let's go and eat.
column9: After, afterwards: 下班之後 "after work", 三天之後 "three days later". It follows the phrase it modifies, and can also stand alone at the start: 之後，我們… "afterwards we…". The opposite is 之前. 之後 is a bit more formal than 以後.

column3: Within, inside of a limit of time, distance or number: 三天以内 "within three days", 一公里以内, 十岁以内. The limit is included. 以 marks a boundary and 内 "inside". The opposite is 以外.
column6: Qǐng zài sān tiān yǐnèi wánchéng.
column7: Please finish it within three days.
column9: Within, inside of a limit of time, distance or number: 三天以內 "within three days", 一公里以內, 十歲以內. The limit is included. 以 marks a boundary and 內 "inside". The opposite is 以外.

column3: Between, among: 医院和银行之间 "between the hospital and the bank", 朋友之间 "between friends". It follows the two things, joined by 和 or 与, or a plural noun. It gives a position, a relation or a range.
column4: 学校在医院和银行之间。
column5: 學校在醫院和銀行之間。
column6: Xuéxiào zài yīyuàn hé yínháng zhījiān.
column7: The school is between the hospital and the bank.
column9: Between, among: 醫院和銀行之間 "between the hospital and the bank", 朋友之間 "between friends". It follows the two things, joined by 和 or 與, or a plural noun. It gives a position, a relation or a range.

column3: Shopping, buying things: 购物中心 "shopping center", 网上购物 "online shopping", 去购物. It is a formal word for buying, and a quite general one. The verb for buying a single thing is 买. 购 has 贝 "shell, money".
column6: Wǒ xǐhuan zài wǎngshàng gòuwù.
column7: I like shopping online.
column9: Shopping, buying things: 購物中心 "shopping center", 網上購物 "online shopping", 去購物. It is a formal word for buying, and a quite general one. The verb for buying a single thing is 買. 購 has 貝 "shell, money".

column3: To purchase, buy, more formal than 买: 购买机票, 购买力 "buying power". It suits writing, notices, and websites: 在线购买. The object is usually a thing of some value or a service, not a small item. 购 "buy" and 买 "buy" are near-synonyms.
column4: 你可以在网上购买火车票。
column5: 你可以在網上購買火車票。
column6: Nǐ kěyǐ zài wǎngshàng gòumǎi huǒchēpiào.
column7: You can buy train tickets online.
column9: To purchase, buy, more formal than 買: 購買機票, 購買力 "buying power". It suits writing, notices, and websites: 在線購買. The object is usually a thing of some value or a service, not a small item. 購 "buy" and 買 "buy" are near-synonyms.

column3: To sell, put on sale: 出售房屋 "house for sale", 正在出售, 出售商品. It appears in ads and signs more than in speech, where 卖 is used. 出 "out" plus 售 "sell". 售 has 隹 "bird" over 口 "mouth", a seller calling out.
column6: Zhè tào fángzi zhèngzài chūshòu.
column7: This apartment is for sale.
column9: To sell, put on sale: 出售房屋 "house for sale", 正在出售, 出售商品. It appears in ads and signs more than in speech, where 賣 is used. 出 "out" plus 售 "sell". 售 has 隹 "bird" over 口 "mouth", a seller calling out.

column3: Goods, merchandise: 一批货 "a batch of goods", 进货 "stock up", 发货 "ship goods", 货物 "cargo". On its own it needs a modifier or a verb. It is also "currency" in 货币. The 贝 "shell, money" is at the bottom, and 化 gives the sound.
column6: Zhè pī huò míngtiān jiù dào.
column7: This batch of goods arrives tomorrow.
column9: Goods, merchandise: 一批貨 "a batch of goods", 進貨 "stock up", 發貨 "ship goods", 貨物 "cargo". On its own it needs a modifier or a verb. It is also "currency" in 貨幣. The 貝 "shell, money" is at the bottom, and 化 gives the sound.

column3: Special price, a sale price: 特价商品 "goods on sale", 今日特价 "today's special". It appears on signs. 特 is "special" and 价 "price". Compare 打折 "give a discount".
column6: Jīntiān zhè jiàn yīfu tèjià.
column7: This item of clothing is on sale today.
column9: Special price, a sale price: 特價商品 "goods on sale", 今日特價 "today's special". It appears on signs. 特 is "special" and 價 "price". Compare 打折 "give a discount".

column3: To give a discount: 打折了, 打八折 "take 20% off", 打折扣. 折 is a tenth of the price: 八折 means 80% of the price. A verb and its object, so 打了折. For the customer, 打折 means that the price has gone down.
column6: Zhè jiā diàn xiànzài dǎzhé.
column7: This store has a sale now.
column9: To give a discount: 打折了, 打八折 "take 20% off", 打折扣. 折 is a tenth of the price: 八折 means 80% of the price. A verb and its object, so 打了折. For the customer, 打折 means that the price has gone down.

column3: Here the discount: 打八折 "20% off", where the number is the tenths of the price you still pay: 八折 is 80%, and 七折 is 70%. Elsewhere 折 means "to fold" or "to break": 折纸 "paper folding", 骨折 "broken bone". 折 is a hand 扌 with an axe 斤.
column6: Zhè jiàn yīfu dǎ qī zhé.
column7: This item is 30% off.
column9: Here the discount: 打八折 "20% off", where the number is the tenths of the price you still pay: 八折 is 80%, and 七折 is 70%. Elsewhere 折 means "to fold" or "to break": 摺紙 "paper folding", 骨折 "broken bone". 折 is a hand 扌 with an axe 斤.

column3: To cut the price, go down in price: 降价了, 大降价 "big sale", 降价销售. A verb and its object. The opposite is 涨价. 降 "lower" is read jiàng, and 价 "price".
column6: Zhè kuǎn shǒujī jiàngjià le.
column7: This phone has gone down in price.
column9: To cut the price, go down in price: 降價了, 大降價 "big sale", 降價銷售. A verb and its object. The opposite is 漲價. 降 "lower" is read jiàng, and 價 "price".

column3: A high price: 高价买, 高价出售, 高价格 is also heard. The opposite is 低价. It often has the idea of paying too much: 用高价买了…. 高 shows a tall building.
column4: 他用高价买了一块手表。
column5: 他用高價買了一塊手錶。
column6: Tā yòng gāojià mǎi le yī kuài shǒubiǎo.
column7: He bought a watch at a high price.
column9: A high price: 高價買, 高價出售, 高價格 is also heard. The opposite is 低價. It often has the idea of paying too much: 用高價買了…. 高 shows a tall building.

column3: Free of charge: 免费的, 免费提供 "provide free", 免费试用 "free trial". It means no payment is asked, unlike 不要钱, which is spoken. 免 is "to avoid" and 费 "fee, cost". 费 has 贝 "money" at the bottom.
column6: Zhèlǐ de tíngchē shì miǎnfèi de.
column7: Parking here is free.
column9: Free of charge: 免費的, 免費提供 "provide free", 免費試用 "free trial". It means no payment is asked, unlike 不要錢, which is spoken. 免 is "to avoid" and 費 "fee, cost". 費 has 貝 "money" at the bottom.

column3: An "invoice, receipt" the official tax receipt: 开发票 "issue a receipt", 要发票 "ask for a receipt". 发 is "to issue", 票 a "ticket". Taiwan's 统一发票 also works as a lottery ticket.
column6: Qǐng gěi wǒ kāi yī zhāng fāpiào.
column7: Please issue me a receipt.
column9: An "invoice, receipt" the official tax receipt: 開發票 "issue a receipt", 要發票 "ask for a receipt". 發 is "to issue", 票 a "ticket". Taiwan's 統一發票 also works as a lottery ticket.

column3: A sales "promotion": 促销活动, 促销价 "promotional price", 做促销. It is used in stores for sales events, discounts and gifts. 促 means "to urge, to speed up" and has 亻 and 足 "foot" for pressing on your heels, and 销 is "to sell".
column6: Shāngchǎng zhèngzài gǎo cùxiāo huódòng.
column7: The mall is running a promotion.
column9: A sales "promotion": 促銷活動, 促銷價 "promotional price", 做促銷. It is used in stores for sales events, discounts and gifts. 促 means "to urge, to speed up" and has 亻 and 足 "foot" for pressing on your heels, and 銷 is "to sell".

column3: To promote and sell, to push a product: 推销产品, 推销员 "salesman". Often pushy: 他在推销保险 "he is peddling insurance". 推 is "push" and 销 "sell". The seller approaches the customer.
column4: 他想向我推销一个新产品。
column5: 他想向我推銷一個新產品。
column6: Tā xiǎng xiàng wǒ tuīxiāo yī ge xīn chǎnpǐn.
column7: He wants to sell me a new product.
column9: To promote and sell, to push a product: 推銷產品, 推銷員 "salesman". Often pushy: 他在推銷保險 "he is peddling insurance". 推 is "push" and 銷 "sell". The seller approaches the customer.

column3: Sales; to sell: 销售员 "salesperson", 销售额 "sales figures", 做销售 "work in sales". It is the business word for selling in volume, and also a job: 他在做销售. 销 "sell" and 售 "sell".
column6: Tā zài yī jiā gōngsī zuò xiāoshòu.
column7: He works in sales at a company.
column9: Sales; to sell: 銷售員 "salesperson", 銷售額 "sales figures", 做銷售 "work in sales". It is the business word for selling in volume, and also a job: 他在做銷售. 銷 "sell" and 售 "sell".

column3: To import, "imported": 进口水果 "imported fruit", 进口汽车. Also an "entrance": 进口在左边. The opposite is 出口, "export, exit". 进 has 辶 "walk". Imports are goods that "enter the mouth" of the country.
column6: Zhèxiē shuǐguǒ shì jìnkǒu de.
column7: This fruit is imported.
column9: To import, "imported": 進口水果 "imported fruit", 進口汽車. Also an "entrance": 進口在左邊. The opposite is 出口, "export, exit". 進 has 辶 "walk". Imports are goods that "enter the mouth" of the country.

column3: To choose, pick out, careful selection from several: 挑一件, 挑水果, 挑颜色. Also "to find fault": 挑毛病. Also read tiǎo for "to lift, to raise", which is a different word. 扌 "hand" is the meaning part and 兆 the sound.
column6: Nǐ zìjǐ tiāo yī jiàn ba.
column7: Pick one yourself.
column9: To choose, pick out, careful selection from several: 挑一件, 挑水果, 挑顏色. Also "to find fault": 挑毛病. Also read tiǎo for "to lift, to raise", which is a different word. 扌 "hand" is the meaning part and 兆 the sound.

column3: To select, choose carefully: 挑选水果, 仔细挑选. It is the same idea as 挑, but formal, and two characters. 选 has 辶. The result is the best among many, as in 挑选礼物 "choose a gift".
column6: Tā zài rènzhēn de tiāoxuǎn shuǐguǒ.
column7: She is carefully choosing fruit.
column9: To select, choose carefully: 挑選水果, 仔細挑選. It is the same idea as 挑, but formal, and two characters. 選 has 辶. The result is the best among many, as in 挑選禮物 "choose a gift".

column3: To put, arrange, set out things in a place: 摆在桌子上 "put on the table", 摆放整齐 "arrange neatly", 摆摊 "set up a stall". Also "to swing, wave": 摆手 "wave the hand" and a pendulum. 扌 "hand" is the meaning part.
column6: Tā bǎ shū bǎi zài zhuōzi shàng.
column7: He put the books on the table.
column9: To put, arrange, set out things in a place: 擺在桌子上 "put on the table", 擺放整齊 "arrange neatly", 擺攤 "set up a stall". Also "to swing, wave": 擺手 "wave the hand" and a pendulum. 扌 "hand" is the meaning part.

column3: Second-hand, used goods: 二手车 "used car", 二手房 "resale home", 二手书, and 二手烟 "second-hand smoke". It goes before the noun. 二 "two" and 手 "hand", so goods that have passed through a second pair of hands.
column6: Wǒ xiǎng mǎi yī liàng èrshǒu chē.
column7: I want to buy a used car.
column9: Second-hand, used goods: 二手車 "used car", 二手房 "resale home", 二手書, and 二手煙 "second-hand smoke". It goes before the noun. 二 "two" and 手 "hand", so goods that have passed through a second pair of hands.

column3: To draw a prize, hold a raffle: 参加抽奖 "enter the draw", 抽奖活动. Shops, banks and companies do this. It is a verb and its object: 抽了一次奖. 抽 is "to draw out" and 奖 "prize". After 抽奖 comes 中奖 "to win".
column6: Mǎi dōngxi kěyǐ cānjiā chōujiǎng.
column7: When you shop you can enter the prize draw.
column9: To draw a prize, hold a raffle: 參加抽獎 "enter the draw", 抽獎活動. Shops, banks and companies do this. It is a verb and its object: 抽了一次獎. 抽 is "to draw out" and 獎 "prize". After 抽獎 comes 中獎 "to win".

column3: To win a prize in a draw or lottery: 中奖了, 中了一等奖 "won first prize". The 中 is read zhòng, "to hit the mark", and not zhōng. 奖 is a "prize". It is luck: 中奖 follows 抽奖, whereas for a contest you win 获奖.
column6: Tā zhòngjiǎng le, fēicháng gāoxìng.
column7: He won a prize and is very happy.
column9: To win a prize in a draw or lottery: 中獎了, 中了一等獎 "won first prize". The 中 is read zhòng, "to hit the mark", and not zhōng. 獎 is a "prize". It is luck: 中獎 follows 抽獎, whereas for a contest you win 獲獎.

column3: A "red envelope" with money, given at Spring Festival, weddings and birthdays: 发红包 "give red envelopes", 收红包. Today people also send them as digital money through WeChat. 红包 can also be a bonus or a bribe, depending on the context. 红 "red" has 纟 for the silk and 工 for the sound; 包 is "wrap".
column4: 过年的时候，爷爷给孩子们红包。
column5: 過年的時候，爺爺給孩子們紅包。
column6: Guònián de shíhou, yéye gěi háizimen hóngbāo.
column7: At New Year, Grandpa gives the children red envelopes.
column9: A "red envelope" with money, given at Spring Festival, weddings and birthdays: 發紅包 "give red envelopes", 收紅包. Today people also send them as digital money through WeChat. 紅包 can also be a bonus or a bribe, depending on the context. 紅 "red" has 糹 for the silk and 工 for the sound; 包 is "wrap".

column3: Several things: a "sign, plaque" (招牌), a "brand" (牌子, 名牌), and a "playing card" or mahjong tile: 打牌 "play cards". The measure word is 张 for cards and 块 for signs. 片 "slice, flat piece" is the meaning part, and 卑 the sound.
column6: Tāmen zài jiā dǎ pái.
column7: They are playing cards at home.
column9: Several things: a "sign, plaque" (招牌), a "brand" (牌子, 名牌), and a "playing card" or mahjong tile: 打牌 "play cards". The measure word is 張 for cards and 塊 for signs. 片 "slice, flat piece" is the meaning part, and 卑 the sound.

column3: A famous "brand", or something of a famous brand: 名牌儿衣服, 穿名牌儿. It is the erhua form of 名牌, said in the north. 牌 is a "brand" and 名 "famous", where 名 is a mouth 口 calling out a name in the dark 夕. The 儿 only changes the ending: míngpáir.
column6: Tā xǐhuan chuān míngpáir.
column7: He likes to wear brand-name clothes.
column9: A famous "brand", or something of a famous brand: 名牌兒衣服, 穿名牌兒. It is the erhua form of 名牌, said in the north. 牌 is a "brand" and 名 "famous", where 名 is a mouth 口 calling out a name in the dark 夕. The 兒 only changes the ending: míngpáir.

column3: A "product": 新产品 "new product", 电子产品 "electronics", 产品质量. A thing that is made or sold by a company. 产 means "to produce", and 品 is "goods", three mouths 口 (many people talking about a thing).
column4: 这家公司的产品卖得很好。
column5: 這家公司的產品賣得很好。
column6: Zhè jiā gōngsī de chǎnpǐn mài de hěn hǎo.
column7: This company's products sell well.
column9: A "product": 新產品 "new product", 電子產品 "electronics", 產品質量. A thing that is made or sold by a company. 產 means "to produce", and 品 is "goods", three mouths 口 (many people talking about a thing).

column3: Quality, the inherent excellence of a product, or a person's moral character: 品质好 "of good quality", 优良的品质 "fine qualities". It stresses what the thing is made of. 品 "goods, character" and 质 "substance". 质 has 贝 "shell, money" within.
column6: Zhè zhǒng chǎnpǐn de pǐnzhì hěn gāo.
column7: This product is of high quality.
column9: Quality, the inherent excellence of a product, or a person's moral character: 品質好 "of good quality", 優良的品質 "fine qualities". It stresses what the thing is made of. 品 "goods, character" and 質 "substance". 質 has 貝 "shell, money" within.

column3: Quality: 质量好 "good quality", 质量差, 质量问题 "quality problems". It is the usual word for how good something is. In physics it also means "mass". 质 "substance" and 量 "amount". The reading is zhìliàng, not zhíliáng.
column4: 这家店的东西质量很好。
column5: 這家店的東西質量很好。
column6: Zhè jiā diàn de dōngxi zhìliàng hěn hǎo.
column7: The goods in this store are of good quality.
column9: Quality: 質量好 "good quality", 質量差, 質量問題 "quality problems". It is the usual word for how good something is. In physics it also means "mass". 質 "substance" and 量 "amount". The reading is zhìliàng, not zhíliáng.

column3: Material: 建筑材料 "building materials", 原材料. Also "data, documents": 学习材料 "study material", 准备材料 "prepare documents" (e.g., for an application). The context decides the meaning. 材 has 木 "wood" and 才, and 料 has 米 and 斗, rice being measured.
column4: 这些材料是从国外进口的。
column5: 這些材料是從國外進口的。
column6: Zhèxiē cáiliào shì cóng guówài jìnkǒu de.
column7: These materials are imported from abroad.
column9: Material: 建築材料 "building materials", 原材料. Also "data, documents": 學習材料 "study material", 準備材料 "prepare documents" (e.g., for an application). The context decides the meaning. 材 has 木 "wood" and 才, and 料 has 米 and 斗, rice being measured.

column3: Raw material: 食品原料, 原料价格. It is the stuff that is turned into a product, for example flour for bread. 原 is "origin, original" and 料 "material". The word shows up in production and food.
column4: 这些面包的原料很新鲜。
column5: 這些麵包的原料很新鮮。
column6: Zhèxiē miànbāo de yuánliào hěn xīnxiān.
column7: The ingredients of this bread are very fresh.
column9: Raw material: 食品原料, 原料價格. It is the stuff that is turned into a product, for example flour for bread. 原 is "origin, original" and 料 "material". The word shows up in production and food.

column3: Plastic: 塑料袋, 塑料瓶 "plastic bottle", 塑料制品. In Taiwan, 塑胶 is the more common word. 塑 means "to mold" and has 土 "earth", clay, at the bottom; 料 is "material".
column6: Zhège bēizi shì sùliào zuò de.
column7: This cup is made of plastic.
column9: Plastic: 塑料袋, 塑料瓶 "plastic bottle", 塑料制品. In Taiwan, 塑膠 is the more common word. 塑 means "to mold" and has 土 "earth", clay, at the bottom; 料 is "material".

column3: Fuel: 燃料价格, 汽车燃料, 清洁燃料. It names anything burned for energy, such as coal, gasoline or gas. 燃 has 火 "fire" and 然, which gives the sound. 料 is "material".
column4: 汽车需要燃料才能开动。
column5: 汽車需要燃料才能開動。
column6: Qìchē xūyào ránliào cáinéng kāidòng.
column7: A car needs fuel before it can move.
column9: Fuel: 燃料價格, 汽車燃料, 清潔燃料. It names anything burned for energy, such as coal, gasoline or gas. 燃 has 火 "fire" and 然, which gives the sound. 料 is "material".

column3: To burn, combust: 燃烧起来 "burst into flames", 完全燃烧. It is the scientific or neutral word for fire in action. 燃 "ignite" and 烧 "burn", both with 火 "fire". Things that burn include wood, gas or oil.
column6: Huǒ zài lúzi lǐ ránshāo.
column7: The fire is burning in the stove.
column9: To burn, combust: 燃燒起來 "burst into flames", 完全燃燒. It is the scientific or neutral word for fire in action. 燃 "ignite" and 燒 "burn", both with 火 "fire". Things that burn include wood, gas or oil.

column3: To catch fire: 着火了 "it's on fire!", 房子着火了. It also means to ignite: 容易着火 "easily set on fire". Here 着 is read zháo, not zhe. For a fire in general the word is 火灾.
column6: Fángzi zháohuǒ le, kuài dǎ diànhuà!
column7: The house is on fire, call quickly!
column9: To catch fire: 著火了 "it's on fire!", 房子著火了. It also means to ignite: 容易著火 "easily set on fire". Here 著 is read zháo, not zhe. For a fire in general the word is 火災.

column3: To burn: 烧火 "make a fire", 烧毁 "burn down". Also "to heat, boil, cook": 烧水 "boil water", 烧菜 "cook dishes", and "to have a fever": 发烧. 火 "fire" is the meaning part and 尧 the sound.
column6: Wǒ qù shāo diǎnr shuǐ.
column7: I'll go and boil some water.
column9: To burn: 燒火 "make a fire", 燒毀 "burn down". Also "to heat, boil, cook": 燒水 "boil water", 燒菜 "cook dishes", and "to have a fever": 發燒. 火 "fire" is the meaning part and 堯 the sound.

column3: Gasoline: 加汽油 "fill up with gas", 汽油车 "gasoline car", 汽油价格. It is the fuel for cars. 汽 "steam, gas" and 油 "oil". The other fuel is 柴油 "diesel". Today an electric car is called 电动汽车.
column6: Qìchē méiyǒu qìyóu le.
column7: The car is out of gas.
column9: Gasoline: 加汽油 "fill up with gas", 汽油車 "gasoline car", 汽油價格. It is the fuel for cars. 汽 "steam, gas" and 油 "oil". The other fuel is 柴油 "diesel". Today an electric car is called 電動汽車.

column3: Resources: 自然资源 "natural resources", 水资源 "water resources", 人力资源 "human resources", 资源丰富 "rich in resources". It is a general noun for what a place or an organization has to use. 资 has 贝 "money", and 源 has 氵 "water" for a spring source.
column6: Shuǐ shì hěn zhòngyào de zīyuán.
column7: Water is a very important resource.
column9: Resources: 自然資源 "natural resources", 水資源 "water resources", 人力資源 "human resources", 資源豐富 "rich in resources". It is a general noun for what a place or an organization has to use. 資 has 貝 "money", and 源 has 氵 "water" for a spring source.

column3: A "power source, power supply": 打开电源 "switch on the power", 电源线 "power cord", 电源插座. For a device it is the power button or the outlet. 电 "electricity" and 源 "source", with 氵 "water" for a spring.
column6: Qǐng xiān dǎkāi diànyuán.
column7: Please turn the power on first.
column9: A "power source, power supply": 打開電源 "switch on the power", 電源線 "power cord", 電源插座. For a device it is the power button or the outlet. 電 "electricity" and 源 "source", with 氵 "water" for a spring.

column3: Treasure, precious thing: 宝贝, 宝石, 国宝 "national treasure". On its own 当成宝 means "to treat as a treasure". 宝 is a jade 玉 kept in a house 宀.
column6: Tā bǎ zhè běn shū dàngchéng bǎo.
column7: He treats this book as a treasure.
column9: Treasure, precious thing: 寶貝, 寶石, 國寶 "national treasure". On its own 當成寶 means "to treat as a treasure". 寶 is a jade 珤 and a shell 貝 for money kept in a house 宀.

column3: A "gem, precious stone": 红宝石 "ruby", 蓝宝石 "sapphire", 宝石戒指. 宝 "treasure" and 石 "stone". It is the word for the cut stones of jewelry. 石 is a rock 口 under a cliff 厂.
column6: Zhè kē bǎoshí fēicháng piàoliang.
column7: This gem is very beautiful.
column9: A "gem, precious stone": 紅寶石 "ruby", 藍寶石 "sapphire", 寶石戒指. 寶 "treasure" and 石 "stone". It is the word for the cut stones of jewelry. 石 is a rock 口 under a cliff 厂.

column3: Valuable, precious, for something not money: 宝贵的时间 "precious time", 宝贵的经验 "valuable experience", 宝贵意见 "valuable opinions". Also a verb "to treasure". It is a polite word for another person's time or advice. 宝 is treasure and 贵 "expensive".
column6: Shíjiān shì fēicháng bǎoguì de.
column7: Time is very precious.
column9: Valuable, precious, for something not money: 寶貴的時間 "precious time", 寶貴的經驗 "valuable experience", 寶貴意見 "valuable opinions". Also a verb "to treasure". It is a polite word for another person's time or advice. 寶 is treasure and 貴 "expensive".

column3: Jade, the stone that Chinese culture prizes: 玉石, 玉镯 "jade bracelet", 玉器 "jade ware". It stands for beauty and purity: 玉 is also used in names. The character is three pieces on a string. As a radical, the 玉 becomes 王 on the left, as in 球 and 现.
column6: Zhè kuài yù hěn guì.
column7: This piece of jade is very expensive.
column9: Jade, the stone that Chinese culture prizes: 玉石, 玉鐲 "jade bracelet", 玉器 "jade ware". It stands for beauty and purity: 玉 is also used in names. The character is three pieces on a string. As a radical, the 玉 becomes 王 on the left, as in 球 and 現.

column3: Gold: 黄金首饰 "gold jewelry", 黄金价格. Figuratively "golden": 黄金时间 "prime time", 黄金周 "Golden Week", 黄金时代 "golden age". 黄 is "yellow" and 金 "metal, gold".
column6: Huángjīn de jiàgé yòu zhǎng le.
column7: The price of gold has gone up again.
column9: Gold: 黃金首飾 "gold jewelry", 黃金價格. Figuratively "golden": 黃金時間 "prime time", 黃金週 "Golden Week", 黃金時代 "golden age". 黃 is "yellow" and 金 "metal, gold".

column3: US dollars: 二十美金, 兑换美金. This is the spoken word, particularly in Taiwan and overseas communities. The mainland says 美元 in formal use. 美 "American" and 金 "money, gold". It is also used with other currencies as 日金 or 港金.
column6: Zhè běn shū mài èrshí měijīn.
column7: This book sells for twenty US dollars.
column9: US dollars: 二十美金, 兌換美金. This is the spoken word, particularly in Taiwan and overseas communities. The mainland says 美元 in formal use. 美 "American" and 金 "money, gold". It is also used with other currencies as 日金 or 港金.

column3: Foreign currency; foreign exchange: 外汇储备 "foreign exchange reserves", 兑换外汇 "exchange foreign currency", 外汇市场. 外 is "foreign, outside" and 汇 "to remit, exchange".
column6: Qù yínháng kěyǐ duìhuàn wàihuì.
column7: You can exchange foreign currency at the bank.
column9: Foreign currency; foreign exchange: 外匯儲備 "foreign exchange reserves", 兌換外匯 "exchange foreign currency", 外匯市場. 外 is "foreign, outside" and 匯 "to remit, exchange".

column3: To remit money: 汇钱 "send money", 汇款 "remittance", and "to converge": 汇合 "meet up, join". 氵 "water" and 匚 "box": water flowing together into one container.
column6: Wǒ yào gěi jiālǐ huì qián.
column7: I want to send money home.
column9: To remit money: 匯錢 "send money", 匯款 "remittance", and "to converge": 匯合 "meet up, join". 氵 "water" and 匚 "box": water flowing together into one container.

column3: Exchange rate: 今天的汇率, 人民币汇率 "the RMB exchange rate". 汇 is "exchange" and 率 "rate". 率 is read lǜ here, and shuài in 率领 "to lead". The word 率 is also in 比率 and 利率 "interest rate".
column6: Jīntiān de huìlǜ shì duōshao?
column7: What is today's exchange rate?
column9: Exchange rate: 今天的匯率, 人民幣匯率 "the RMB exchange rate". 匯 is "exchange" and 率 "rate". 率 is read lǜ here, and shuài in 率領 "to lead". The word 率 is also in 比率 and 利率 "interest rate".

column3: Interest on money: 银行利息, 利息很高, 付利息 "pay interest". It is the interest earned on savings or owed on a loan. 利 is "profit" and has 禾 "grain" with 刂 "knife", reaping the crop. 息 means "breath", as well as "interest", which came from money "breeding".
column6: Yínháng de lìxī hěn dī.
column7: The bank's interest is very low.
column9: Interest on money: 銀行利息, 利息很高, 付利息 "pay interest". It is the interest earned on savings or owed on a loan. 利 is "profit" and has 禾 "grain" with 刂 "knife", reaping the crop. 息 means "breath", as well as "interest", which came from money "breeding".

column3: A "bonus" paid with the wage, as a reward: 年终奖金 "year-end bonus", 发奖金, 拿奖金. It is also prize money in a competition. 奖 "prize" plus 金 "money". Often awarded at the end of a year or after a good result.
column6: Niándǐ gōngsī fā le jiǎngjīn.
column7: At the end of the year the company paid out bonuses.
column9: A "bonus" paid with the wage, as a reward: 年終獎金 "year-end bonus", 發獎金, 拿獎金. It is also prize money in a competition. 獎 "prize" plus 金 "money". Often awarded at the end of a year or after a good result.

column3: A "scholarship": 申请奖学金 "apply for a scholarship", 拿到奖学金, 全额奖学金 "full scholarship". It is money given to a student for good grades or as aid. 奖 "prize" + 学 "study" + 金 "money".
column6: Tā nádào le jiǎngxuéjīn.
column7: She was awarded a scholarship.
column9: A "scholarship": 申請獎學金 "apply for a scholarship", 拿到獎學金, 全額獎學金 "full scholarship". It is money given to a student for good grades or as aid. 獎 "prize" + 學 "study" + 金 "money".

column3: Property, assets: 个人财产 "personal property", 财产安全, 继承财产 "inherit property". It means belongings of value: money, houses, goods. 财 has 贝 "money" and 才, and 产 "to produce". The legal word for a real property is 房产.
column4: 他把财产都留给了孩子。
column5: 他把財產都留給了孩子。
column6: Tā bǎ cáichǎn dōu liú gěi le háizi.
column7: He left all his property to his children.
column9: Property, assets: 個人財產 "personal property", 財產安全, 繼承財產 "inherit property". It means belongings of value: money, houses, goods. 財 has 貝 "money" and 才, and 產 "to produce". The legal word for a real property is 房產.

column3: Wealth, riches: 创造财富 "create wealth", 财富增长, 一笔财富. The word also covers non-money value: 知识是财富. 财 "money" and 富 "rich", where 富 has 宀 "roof" and 畐. The word is more written than 钱.
column6: Jiànkāng bǐ cáifù gèng zhòngyào.
column7: Health is more important than wealth.
column9: Wealth, riches: 創造財富 "create wealth", 財富增長, 一筆財富. The word also covers non-money value: 知識是財富. 財 "money" and 富 "rich", where 富 has 宀 "roof" and 畐. The word is more written than 錢.

column3: To invest; investment: 投资股票 "invest in stocks", 投资房地产, 一项投资. 投 means "to throw in" with 扌 "hand" and 资 "capital, funds". It is both verb and noun. A person who invests is 投资者.
column6: Tā xiǎng tóuzī yī jiā xiǎo gōngsī.
column7: He wants to invest in a small company.
column9: To invest; investment: 投資股票 "invest in stocks", 投資房地產, 一項投資. 投 means "to throw in" with 扌 "hand" and 資 "capital, funds". It is both verb and noun. A person who invests is 投資者.

column3: To go bankrupt: 公司破产了, 宣布破产 "declare bankruptcy". For a person it can also mean being ruined. 破 means "to break" and has 石 "rock" with 皮, and 产 "property". So the property is broken.
column6: Nà jiā gōngsī qùnián pòchǎn le.
column7: That company went bankrupt last year.
column9: To go bankrupt: 公司破產了, 宣布破產 "declare bankruptcy". For a person it can also mean being ruined. 破 means "to break" and has 石 "rock" with 皮, and 產 "property". So the property is broken.

column3: To go out of business, to close down, of a shop or company: 倒闭了, 面临倒闭. Compare 破产, which is about legal bankruptcy. 倒 is read dǎo here, "to fall, collapse", and 闭 is "to close".
column4: 这家小店因为生意不好倒闭了。
column5: 這家小店因為生意不好倒閉了。
column6: Zhè jiā xiǎo diàn yīnwèi shēngyi bù hǎo dǎobì le.
column7: This little shop closed because business was bad.
column9: To go out of business, to close down, of a shop or company: 倒閉了, 面臨倒閉. Compare 破產, which is about legal bankruptcy. 倒 is read dǎo here, "to fall, collapse", and 閉 is "to close".

column3: Benefit, interests: 个人利益, 国家利益, 保护利益 "protect interests", 利益冲突 "conflict of interest". It often means what someone gains or stands to gain. 利 "profit" and 益 "benefit", where 益 shows water 水 overflowing from a dish 皿.
column6: Tā zhǐ kǎolǜ zìjǐ de lìyì.
column7: He only thinks about his own interests.
column9: Benefit, interests: 個人利益, 國家利益, 保護利益 "protect interests", 利益衝突 "conflict of interest". It often means what someone gains or stands to gain. 利 "profit" and 益 "benefit", where 益 shows water 水 overflowing from a dish 皿.

column3: Earnings, returns, profit from an investment or business: 投资收益, 收益率 "rate of return", 增加收益. It is a financial word. 收 is "to receive" and 益 "benefit". Compare 利息, the interest, and 利益, the interests.
column6: Zhège tóuzī de shōuyì bù gāo.
column7: The return on this investment is not high.
column9: Earnings, returns, profit from an investment or business: 投資收益, 收益率 "rate of return", 增加收益. It is a financial word. 收 is "to receive" and 益 "benefit". Compare 利息, the interest, and 利益, the interests.

column3: To guarantee, vouch for: 为他担保 "vouch for him", 担保人 "guarantor", 担保贷款. In law and loans it means taking responsibility for someone else's debt or action. 担 is "to carry, take on" and 保 "to protect".
column6: Wǒ kěyǐ wèi tā dānbǎo.
column7: I can vouch for him.
column9: To guarantee, vouch for: 為他擔保 "vouch for him", 擔保人 "guarantor", 擔保貸款. In law and loans it means taking responsibility for someone else's debt or action. 擔 is "to carry, take on" and 保 "to protect".

column3: To pay out, to give effort, time, or cost: 付出努力 "put in effort", 付出代价 "pay the price", 付出时间. Often about what one invests, with a view to a return. 付 is "to pay" and 出 "out", where 付 shows a person handing something to another.
column4: 成功需要付出很多努力。
column5: 成功需要付出很多努力。
column6: Chénggōng xūyào fùchū hěn duō nǔlì.
column7: Success takes a lot of effort.
column9: To pay out, to give effort, time, or cost: 付出努力 "put in effort", 付出代價 "pay the price", 付出時間. Often about what one invests, with a view to a return. 付 is "to pay" and 出 "out", where 付 shows a person handing something to another.

column3: A "burden" or "to bear" a cost: 经济负担 "financial burden", 负担得起 "can afford", 负担费用. The noun is something heavy for you to carry. 负 is "carry on the back" and has 贝 "money", and 担 "to carry".
column4: 学费对这个家庭是一个很大的负担。
column5: 學費對這個家庭是一個很大的負擔。
column6: Xuéfèi duì zhège jiātíng shì yī ge hěn dà de fùdān.
column7: Tuition is a heavy burden for this family.
column9: A "burden" or "to bear" a cost: 經濟負擔 "financial burden", 負擔得起 "can afford", 負擔費用. The noun is something heavy for you to carry. 負 is "carry on the back" and has 貝 "money", and 擔 "to carry".

column3: To save, economize: 节省时间 "save time", 节省开支 "cut costs", 节省用水. It suits time, money and resources. 省 is read shěng here, "to save". The word 省 is also "province".
column6: Wǒmen yào jiéshěng yòng shuǐ.
column7: We must save water.
column9: To save, economize: 節省時間 "save time", 節省開支 "cut costs", 節省用水. It suits time, money and resources. 省 is read shěng here, "to save". The word 省 is also "province".
