column3: A "written notice": 录取通知书 "admission letter", 入学通知书, 缴费通知书. The paper itself, as against 通知 for the act of telling. 通知 "to notify" + 书 "document".
column4: 他收到了大学录取通知书。
column5: 他收到了大學錄取通知書。
column6: Tā shōudào le dàxué lùqǔ tōngzhīshū.
column7: He received his university admission letter.
column9: A "written notice": 錄取通知書 "admission letter", 入學通知書, 繳費通知書. The paper itself, as against 通知 for the act of telling. 通知 "to notify" + 書 "document".

column3: Poor: 很穷, 穷人, 越来越穷. Also "to exhaust" in 穷尽 and "extremely" in some phrases. The opposite is 富. 穷 has the cave 穴 on top, which shows someone with nowhere to go, in a cramped hole.
column6: Tā xiǎoshíhou jiālǐ hěn qióng.
column7: His family was very poor when he was a child.
column9: Poor: 很窮, 窮人, 越來越窮. Also "to exhaust" in 窮盡 and "extremely" in some phrases. The opposite is 富. 窮 has the cave 穴 on top, which shows someone with nowhere to go, in a cramped hole.

column3: An "inheritance" or "legacy": 继承遗产 "inherit an estate", 文化遗产 "cultural heritage", 世界遗产 "World Heritage". It is what one leaves behind, whether money or culture. 遗 is "to leave behind" and 产 "property".
column4: 长城是重要的文化遗产。
column5: 長城是重要的文化遺產。
column6: Chángchéng shì zhòngyào de wénhuà yíchǎn.
column7: The Great Wall is an important cultural heritage.
column9: An "inheritance" or "legacy": 繼承遺產 "inherit an estate", 文化遺產 "cultural heritage", 世界遺產 "World Heritage". It is what one leaves behind, whether money or culture. 遺 is "to leave behind" and 產 "property".

column3: Measure word for trees and other plants standing upright: 一棵树, 一棵白菜, 一棵草. The 木 on the left tells you it belongs with plants, and the 果 on the right gives the sound (kē vs. guǒ, close enough to help you remember). For flowers cut or sold, 朵 and 枝 are used instead.
column6: Yuànzi lǐ yǒu sān kē shù.
column7: There are three trees in the yard.
column9: Measure word for trees and other plants standing upright: 一棵樹, 一棵白菜, 一棵草. The 木 on the left tells you it belongs with plants, and the 果 on the right gives the sound (kē vs. guǒ, close enough to help you remember). For flowers cut or sold, 朵 and 枝 are used instead.

column3: Root, and the measure word for long, thin things: 一根筷子, 一根绳子, 一根头发. As a noun it is "root", as in 树根, and "basis" in 根本 and 根据. 根据 "according to" is built on it. Both meanings come from the 木 plus the 艮 sound.
column6: Tā shǒu lǐ názhe yī gēn shéngzi.
column7: He is holding a piece of rope in his hand.
column9: Root, and the measure word for long, thin things: 一根筷子, 一根繩子, 一根頭髮. As a noun it is "root", as in 樹根, and "basis" in 根本 and 根據. 根據 "according to" is built on it. Both meanings come from the 木 plus the 艮 sound.

column3: Measure word for items, tasks and rules in a list: 一项任务, 一项计划, 一项比赛. It counts the abstract "items" of an official or organized thing, never objects you can pick up. 项 has 页 "head" on the right, which hints at the original sense, the back of the neck.
column4: 这是一项很重要的工作。
column5: 這是一項很重要的工作。
column6: Zhè shì yī xiàng hěn zhòngyào de gōngzuò.
column7: This is a very important piece of work.
column9: Measure word for items, tasks and rules in a list: 一項任務, 一項計劃, 一項比賽. It counts the abstract "items" of an official or organized thing, never objects you can pick up. 項 has 頁 "head" on the right, which hints at the original sense, the back of the neck.

column3: Measure word for households and families: 一户人家, 三户. As a noun it also means a household or an account, as in 户口 and 账户. The character is a picture of a single door leaf, which is why it stands for the home behind it.
column4: 这个村子只有几十户人家。
column5: 這個村子只有幾十戶人家。
column6: Zhège cūnzi zhǐ yǒu jǐshí hù rénjiā.
column7: This village has only a few dozen households.
column9: Measure word for households and families: 一戶人家, 三戶. As a noun it also means a household or an account, as in 戶口 and 帳戶. The character is a picture of a single door leaf, which is why it stands for the home behind it.

column3: Measure word for a batch or group of things or people that arrive or are handled together: 一批货, 一批学生, 第一批. Also a verb meaning "to approve" or "to criticize", as in 批评 and 批准. The 才-like hand 扌 is a clue that it started as an action of the hand.
column6: Dì yī pī kèrén yǐjīng dào le.
column7: The first group of guests has arrived.
column9: Measure word for a batch or group of things or people that arrive or are handled together: 一批貨, 一批學生, 第一批. Also a verb meaning "to approve" or "to criticize", as in 批評 and 批准. The 才-like hand 扌 is a clue that it started as an action of the hand.

column3: Measure word for songs and poems: 一首歌, 一首诗. As a noun it means "head" or "first", so you meet it in 首都 "capital" and 首先 "first of all". The old picture was an animal's head with horns on top.
column6: Tā wèi wǒ chàng le yī shǒu gē.
column7: He sang me a song.
column9: Measure word for songs and poems: 一首歌, 一首詩. As a noun it means "head" or "first", so you meet it in 首都 "capital" and 首先 "first of all". The old picture was an animal's head with horns on top.

column3: Measure word for events that come and go for a short time: 一阵风, 一阵雨, 一阵笑声, 一阵疼. It always counts something sudden or passing, not a state that lasts. The 阝 mark and the 车 inside recall the older sense of troops drawn up in formation.
column6: Tūrán guā qǐ le yī zhèn dàfēng.
column7: A strong gust of wind suddenly blew up.
column9: Measure word for events that come and go for a short time: 一陣風, 一陣雨, 一陣笑聲, 一陣疼. It always counts something sudden or passing, not a state that lasts. The 阝 mark and the 車 inside recall the older sense of troops drawn up in formation.

column3: Noun: circle, ring, loop, and by extension a social circle (朋友圈 "moments", the WeChat feed). Measure word for laps and turns: 跑了三圈. The 囗 around the outside shows an enclosure; the 卷 inside gives the sound, which is why it also reads juàn in 猪圈 "pigsty".
column6: Tā wéizhe cāochǎng pǎo le sān quān.
column7: He ran three laps around the sports field.
column9: Noun: circle, ring, loop, and by extension a social circle (朋友圈 "moments", the WeChat feed). Measure word for laps and turns: 跑了三圈. The 囗 around the outside shows an enclosure; the 卷 inside gives the sound, which is why it also reads juàn in 豬圈 "pigsty".

column3: Measure word for rounds and turns: 一轮比赛, 第二轮, 一轮明月. As a noun, "wheel", as in 轮子 and 轮船 "steamship". Used as a verb it means to take turns: 轮到你了 "it is your turn". The 车 on the left is the cart radical that goes with wheels.
column6: Xià yī lún gāi nǐ shuō le.
column7: In the next round it is your turn to speak.
column9: Measure word for rounds and turns: 一輪比賽, 第二輪, 一輪明月. As a noun, "wheel", as in 輪子 and 輪船 "steamship". Used as a verb it means to take turns: 輪到你了 "it is your turn". The 車 on the left is the cart radical that goes with wheels.

column3: Two people, spoken: 咱俩, 我们俩, 你们俩, 他们俩. It already contains the "two" and the measure word, so never add 两个 or a number after it. It is spoken, northern in feel, and it comes after a pronoun. Here lia is its own syllable (liǎ), not liǎng.
column4: 我们俩是从小一起长大的。
column5: 我們倆是從小一起長大的。
column6: Wǒmen liǎ shì cóng xiǎo yīqǐ zhǎng dà de.
column7: The two of us grew up together.
column9: Two people, spoken: 咱倆, 我們倆, 你們倆, 他們倆. It already contains the "two" and the measure word, so never add 兩個 or a number after it. It is spoken, northern in feel, and it comes after a pronoun. Here lia is its own syllable (liǎ), not liǎng.

column3: Measure word for an unspecified small amount: 一些, 这些, 那些, 哪些, 有些, 好些. It only counts plural or uncountable things and goes after 一, 这, 那 or 哪. 一点儿 and 一些 are close; 一些 can be a little bigger and goes with countable nouns too.
column6: Zhèxiē shū dōu shì wǒ de.
column7: These books are all mine.
column9: Measure word for an unspecified small amount: 一些, 這些, 那些, 哪些, 有些, 好些. It only counts plural or uncountable things and goes after 一, 這, 那 or 哪. 一點兒 and 一些 are close; 一些 can be a little bigger and goes with countable nouns too.

column3: Measure word for a group of people, often with a hint of a gang: 一伙人, 一伙小偷. Often a little negative or casual. It also appears in 伙伴 "partner".
column4: 一伙年轻人在路边聊天。
column5: 一夥年輕人在路邊聊天。
column6: Yī huǒ niánqīngrén zài lùbiān liáotiān.
column7: A group of young people is chatting by the road.
column9: Measure word for a group of people, often with a hint of a gang: 一夥人, 一夥小偷. Often a little negative or casual. It also appears in 夥伴 "partner".

column3: Measure word for a game, round or match: 一局棋, 打了三局. As a noun it is an office or bureau, as in 邮局 and 警察局, and a situation, as in 结局 "outcome". The same character covers all of these, so the context tells which.
column6: Wǒmen xià le yī jú qí.
column7: We played a game of chess.
column9: Measure word for a game, round or match: 一局棋, 打了三局. As a noun it is an office or bureau, as in 郵局 and 警察局, and a situation, as in 結局 "outcome". The same character covers all of these, so the context tells which.

column3: Measure word for dishes served on a plate, and for board games: 一盘菜, 一盘饺子, 一盘棋. As a noun it is a plate or tray, and in 光盘 a disc. The 皿 "dish" at the bottom is the clue to the plate meaning.
column6: Zhuōzi shàng fàngzhe yī pán shuǐguǒ.
column7: There is a plate of fruit on the table.
column9: Measure word for dishes served on a plate, and for board games: 一盤菜, 一盤餃子, 一盤棋. As a noun it is a plate or tray, and in 光盤 a disc. The 皿 "dish" at the bottom is the clue to the plate meaning.

column3: Here dá, "dozen", a borrowed measure word: 一打鸡蛋, 两打啤酒. It is the only place the reading dá is common; everywhere else, such as 打电话 or 打球, it is dǎ. The word comes from English "dozen".
column6: Wǒ mǎi le yī dá jīdàn.
column7: I bought a dozen eggs.
column9: Here dá, "dozen", a borrowed measure word: 一打雞蛋, 兩打啤酒. It is the only place the reading dá is common; everywhere else, such as 打電話 or 打球, it is dǎ. The word comes from English "dozen".

column3: A sound that adds feeling: surprise (啊! "Ah!"), realization, or softening a question or exclamation at the end of a sentence: 你好啊, 真好啊. After a vowel it often changes into ya, and after n into na, which is why 呀 and 哪 exist. Written with 口 for mouth, as most such sounds are.
column6: Ā, wǒ wàng le dài yàoshi!
column7: Oh, I forgot to bring my key!
column9: A sound that adds feeling: surprise (啊! "Ah!"), realization, or softening a question or exclamation at the end of a sentence: 你好啊, 真好啊. After a vowel it often changes into ya, and after n into na, which is why 呀 and 哪 exist. Written with 口 for mouth, as most such sounds are.

column3: The form 啊 takes after a, e, i, o, u or ü: 你好呀, 快来呀, 怎么办呀. It softens a question or adds warmth to a command, in speech rather than writing. It is neutral tone, ya. The 牙 on the right gives the sound; the 口 on the left shows it is a mouth sound.
column6: Nǐ zěnme kū le ya?
column7: Why are you crying?
column9: The form 啊 takes after a, e, i, o, u or ü: 你好呀, 快來呀, 怎麼辦呀. It softens a question or adds warmth to a command, in speech rather than writing. It is neutral tone, ya. The 牙 on the right gives the sound; the 口 on the left shows it is a mouth sound.

column3: Not the question word nǎ "which" but a sentence-ending particle na, used for 啊 after a word that ends in n: 小心哪, 加油哪, 快走哪. It is rare in text; you see it in dialogue and hear it in speech. The 那 on the right is a sound hint, and the same shape gives the question word.
column6: Dàjiā jiāyóu na!
column7: Come on, everyone!
column9: Not the question word nǎ "which" but a sentence-ending particle na, used for 啊 after a word that ends in n: 小心哪, 加油哪, 快走哪. It is rare in text; you see it in dialogue and hear it in speech. The 那 on the right is a sound hint, and the same shape gives the question word.

column3: Greeting or a word to get someone's attention, most often in 打招呼 "say hello": 向他打招呼. Also "to look after" (招呼客人) and "to tell, notify" (招呼一声). The first sense is the common one at this level. 招 means to beckon; 呼 means to call.
column4: 他向我打招呼，我没看见。
column5: 他向我打招呼，我沒看見。
column6: Tā xiàng wǒ dǎ zhāohu, wǒ méi kànjiàn.
column7: He called out a hello to me, but I did not see him.
column9: Greeting or a word to get someone's attention, most often in 打招呼 "say hello": 向他打招呼. Also "to look after" (招呼客人) and "to tell, notify" (招呼一聲). The first sense is the common one at this level. 招 means to beckon; 呼 means to call.

column3: To send greetings, to ask after someone: 问 "ask" plus 候 "wait on, inquire after". You use it for sending good wishes through someone else: 向你父母问候 or 代我问候你家人. It is more formal than 你好 and fits letters and festivals.
column6: Qǐng dài wǒ wènhòu nǐ de fùmǔ.
column7: Please give my regards to your parents.
column9: To send greetings, to ask after someone: 問 "ask" plus 候 "wait on, inquire after". You use it for sending good wishes through someone else: 向你父母問候 or 代我問候你家人. It is more formal than 你好 and fits letters and festivals.

column3: Blessing, to wish well: 祝 "wish" plus 福 "good fortune". As a noun it is the good wishes you give: 送上祝福. As a verb it takes a person and what you wish for: 祝福你们幸福. It is warmer and more formal than 祝 alone, used at weddings, birthdays and New Year.
column4: 我送给他们最好的祝福。
column5: 我送給他們最好的祝福。
column6: Wǒ sòng gěi tāmen zuì hǎo de zhùfú.
column7: I give them my very best wishes.
column9: Blessing, to wish well: 祝 "wish" plus 福 "good fortune". As a noun it is the good wishes you give: 送上祝福. As a verb it takes a person and what you wish for: 祝福你們幸福. It is warmer and more formal than 祝 alone, used at weddings, birthdays and New Year.

column3: To praise, to compliment: 称 "to call, to say" plus 赞 "to commend". It takes a person and often what for: 称赞他勇敢. It fits a teacher or a friend giving credit and is neutral in tone. Notice 称 is chēng here, not chèn.
column6: Lǎoshī chēngzàn le tā de zuòwén.
column7: The teacher praised his essay.
column9: To praise, to compliment: 稱 "to call, to say" plus 讚 "to commend". It takes a person and often what for: 稱讚他勇敢. It fits a teacher or a friend giving credit and is neutral in tone. Notice 稱 is chēng here, not chèn.

column3: To praise publicly, to commend: 表 "show" plus 扬 "raise high". It is what a teacher, boss or leader does to a person in front of others, so the praiser is usually above the praised: 受到表扬 "be commended". For praising a friend, 夸 or 称赞 is more natural.
column4: 老师在全班面前表扬了她。
column5: 老師在全班面前表揚了她。
column6: Lǎoshī zài quán bān miànqián biǎoyáng le tā.
column7: The teacher praised her in front of the whole class.
column9: To praise publicly, to commend: 表 "show" plus 揚 "raise high". It is what a teacher, boss or leader does to a person in front of others, so the praiser is usually above the praised: 受到表揚 "be commended". For praising a friend, 誇 or 稱讚 is more natural.

column3: To admire, to appreciate warmly: 赞 "commend" plus 赏 "appreciate". It is a quiet and formal word about valuing someone's qualities, ideas or work: 赞赏他的勇气. It is more about inner approval than the open praise of 表扬.
column6: Wǒ hěn zànshǎng nǐ de yǒngqì.
column7: I greatly admire your courage.
column9: To admire, to appreciate warmly: 讚 "commend" plus 賞 "appreciate". It is a quiet and formal word about valuing someone's qualities, ideas or work: 讚賞他的勇氣. It is more about inner approval than the open praise of 表揚.

column3: To approve of, to agree with a plan, idea or proposal: 赞成这个办法. It is the opposite of 反对. It takes an object, not a person's feelings: say 我赞成你, 我赞成你的想法, and for yes/no, 我赞成 or 我不赞成. Stronger than 同意 in tone.
column6: Wǒ zànchéng nǐ de xiǎngfǎ.
column7: I agree with your idea.
column9: To approve of, to agree with a plan, idea or proposal: 贊成這個辦法. It is the opposite of 反對. It takes an object, not a person's feelings: say 我贊成你, 我贊成你的想法, and for yes/no, 我贊成 or 我不贊成. Stronger than 同意 in tone.

column3: To sponsor, to give financial support: 赞 "support" plus 助 "help". Used for companies backing events, teams or people: 赞助比赛. The sponsor is 赞助商 and the money 赞助费. 助 combines 力 "strength" with a sound part 且, which is why it means to help with effort.
column4: 这家公司赞助了这次比赛。
column5: 這家公司贊助了這次比賽。
column6: Zhè jiā gōngsī zànzhù le zhè cì bǐsài.
column7: This company sponsored the competition.
column9: To sponsor, to give financial support: 贊 "support" plus 助 "help". Used for companies backing events, teams or people: 贊助比賽. The sponsor is 贊助商 and the money 贊助費. 助 combines 力 "strength" with a sound part 且, which is why it means to help with effort.

column3: A smile, to smile without a sound: 微 "slight" plus 笑 "laugh". It works as a noun (脸上带着微笑) and as a verb (对我微笑). Gentler and more polite than 笑 or 大笑, and often used for service, photographs and quiet warmth.
column6: Tā duì wǒ wēixiào le yīxià.
column7: She gave me a little smile.
column9: A smile, to smile without a sound: 微 "slight" plus 笑 "laugh". It works as a noun (臉上帶著微笑) and as a verb (對我微笑). Gentler and more polite than 笑 or 大笑, and often used for service, photographs and quiet warmth.

column3: Facial expression: 表 "show" plus 情 "feeling". The look on someone's face: 他的表情很严肃, 没有表情 "expressionless". It can also mean emoticon in chat. 情 has 忄 "heart" and 青 for the sound.
column6: Tā de biǎoqíng hěn yánsù.
column7: His expression is very serious.
column9: Facial expression: 表 "show" plus 情 "feeling". The look on someone's face: 他的表情很嚴肅, 沒有表情 "expressionless". It can also mean emoticon in chat. 情 has 忄 "heart" and 青 for the sound.

column3: Mostly part of longer words (欣赏, 赏识, 奖赏), but alone it is "to enjoy the sight of, to admire" in set phrases such as 赏花 and 赏月. It also means to give a reward to someone below you. The 贝 "shell" at the bottom is the old money radical, and 尚 gives the sound.
column6: Zhōngqiūjié wǒmen yīqǐ shǎng yuè.
column7: At the Mid-Autumn Festival we gaze at the moon together.
column9: Mostly part of longer words (欣賞, 賞識, 獎賞), but alone it is "to enjoy the sight of, to admire" in set phrases such as 賞花 and 賞月. It also means to give a reward to someone below you. The 貝 "shell" at the bottom is the old money radical, and 尚 gives the sound.

column3: To graduate: 毕 "finish" plus 业 "course of study, trade". It is a verb with its object built in, so extra things go between: 毕了业, 毕不了业; and you graduate from a place with 从…毕业 or the place before the verb: 他大学毕业. Also a noun in 毕业典礼.
column6: Tā míngnián dàxué bìyè.
column7: He graduates from university next year.
column9: To graduate: 畢 "finish" plus 業 "course of study, trade". It is a verb with its object built in, so extra things go between: 畢了業, 畢不了業; and you graduate from a place with 從…畢業 or the place before the verb: 他大學畢業. Also a noun in 畢業典禮.

column3: A graduate: 毕业 plus 生 "student". Both a person who has just finished school (今年的毕业生 "this year's graduates") and a person who has graduated from a given school. The 生 ending makes a student of some kind, as in 研究生 and 留学生.
column6: Jīnnián de bìyèshēng hěn duō.
column7: There are many graduates this year.
column9: A graduate: 畢業 plus 生 "student". Both a person who has just finished school (今年的畢業生 "this year's graduates") and a person who has graduated from a given school. The 生 ending makes a student of some kind, as in 研究生 and 留學生.

column3: Undergraduate course, bachelor's level: 本 "main, own" plus 科 "subject, course". People say 读本科 or 本科生 "an undergraduate". Next comes 研究生 "graduate student".
column6: Tā zài Běijīng dú běnkē.
column7: He is studying for his bachelor's degree in Beijing.
column9: Undergraduate course, bachelor's level: 本 "main, own" plus 科 "subject, course". People say 讀本科 or 本科生 "an undergraduate". Next comes 研究生 "graduate student".

column3: Graduate student, postgraduate: 研究 "research" plus 生 "student". It covers master's and doctoral students alike; 硕士 and 博士 name the two degrees. The usual way to say you are in graduate school is 读研究生 or just 读研. 研 has 石 "stone" for the old idea of grinding.
column6: Tā zhèngzài dú yánjiūshēng.
column7: She is studying for a graduate degree.
column9: Graduate student, postgraduate: 研究 "research" plus 生 "student". It covers master's and doctoral students alike; 碩士 and 博士 name the two degrees. The usual way to say you are in graduate school is 讀研究生 or just 讀研. 研 has 石 "stone" for the old idea of grinding.

column3: Professor: a university rank, usually with 大学 or a department. 教 "teach" plus 授 "hand over, confer". Can also be used as a title after a name: 王教授. As a verb, "to teach", it is read jiāoshòu, with a first-tone jiāo.
column6: Tā shì dàxué de jiàoshòu.
column7: He is a university professor.
column9: Professor: a university rank, usually with 大學 or a department. 教 "teach" plus 授 "hand over, confer". Can also be used as a title after a name: 王教授. As a verb, "to teach", it is read jiāoshòu, with a first-tone jiāo.

column3: Credit for a course: 学 "study" plus 分 "points". Counted with 个: 三个学分. Typical sentences: 修满学分 "complete the required credits", 这门课几个学分?. Compare 分数, which is a grade or mark.
column6: Zhè mén kè yǒu sān ge xuéfēn.
column7: This course is worth three credits.
column9: Credit for a course: 學 "study" plus 分 "points". Counted with 個: 三個學分. Typical sentences: 修滿學分 "complete the required credits", 這門課幾個學分?. Compare 分數, which is a grade or mark.

column3: Academic year: the school year, from autumn to summer, not the calendar year. 学 plus 年. Compare 学期 "semester", which is half of it. You can say 新学年 "the new school year" or 第二学年 "second year".
column6: Xīn xuénián jiǔ yuè kāishǐ.
column7: The new school year begins in September.
column9: Academic year: the school year, from autumn to summer, not the calendar year. 學 plus 年. Compare 學期 "semester", which is half of it. You can say 新學年 "the new school year" or 第二學年 "second year".

column3: Class hours, the unit in which a course's teaching time is counted: 学 plus 时 "hour". 四十个学时 means forty hours of class. It is a term from the schedule or syllabus, not for ordinary talk about how long you study. 时 is built from 日 "sun/day" and 寸.
column4: 这门课一共有四十个学时。
column5: 這門課一共有四十個學時。
column6: Zhè mén kè yīgòng yǒu sìshí ge xuéshí.
column7: This course has forty class hours in all.
column9: Class hours, the unit in which a course's teaching time is counted: 學 plus 時 "hour". 四十個學時 means forty hours of class. It is a term from the schedule or syllabus, not for ordinary talk about how long you study. 時 is built from 日 "sun/day" and 寸.

column3: Academic, scholarly work: 学 "learning" plus 术 "technique, art". It is an attributive word in compounds: 学术研究, 学术会议, 学术论文. Said of the world of research; not used for ordinary study or a school subject.
column6: Tā zài xuéshù shàng hěn yǒu chéngjiù.
column7: He has achieved a great deal in scholarship.
column9: Academic, scholarly work: 學 "learning" plus 術 "technique, art". It is an attributive word in compounds: 學術研究, 學術會議, 學術論文. Said of the world of research; not used for ordinary study or a school subject.

column3: Learning, knowledge, scholarship: 学 "study" plus 问 "ask". A person with 学问 is learned and well read: 很有学问. It can also mean a field that needs skill: 做饭也是一门学问 "even cooking is a subject in itself". The last syllable may sound neutral in speech.
column6: Tā shì ge hěn yǒu xuéwèn de rén.
column7: He is a very learned man.
column9: Learning, knowledge, scholarship: 學 "study" plus 問 "ask". A person with 學問 is learned and well read: 很有學問. It can also mean a field that needs skill: 做飯也是一門學問 "even cooking is a subject in itself". The last syllable may sound neutral in speech.

column3: Paper, thesis, dissertation: 论 "discuss" plus 文 "writing". Used at university for a graduation thesis (毕业论文) and for articles in journals (发表论文 "publish a paper"). Verbs that go with it: 写, 发表, 交. 论 has the 讠 speech radical and 仑 as its sound.
column6: Tā zhèngzài xiě bìyè lùnwén.
column7: He is writing his graduation thesis.
column9: Paper, thesis, dissertation: 論 "discuss" plus 文 "writing". Used at university for a graduation thesis (畢業論文) and for articles in journals (發表論文 "publish a paper"). Verbs that go with it: 寫, 發表, 交. 論 has the 訁 speech radical and 侖 as its sound.

column3: Winter vacation: 寒 "cold" plus 假 "holiday". It is the break around the Spring Festival, so it matters to students and teachers. Its pair is 暑假. 假 is read jià here, "holiday", but jiǎ in the meaning "false". 寒 shows a person in a house (宀) with grass beneath for warmth.
column6: Hánjià wǒ xiǎng huí jiā.
column7: During the winter break I want to go home.
column9: Winter vacation: 寒 "cold" plus 假 "holiday". It is the break around the Spring Festival, so it matters to students and teachers. Its pair is 暑假. 假 is read jià here, "holiday", but jiǎ in the meaning "false". 寒 shows a person in a house (宀) with grass beneath for warmth.

column3: Summer vacation, the long break from July to August: 暑 "heat of summer" plus 假 "holiday". Used with 放 (放暑假 "begin the summer break") and 过 (过暑假). The 日 in 暑 recalls the sun, and 者 gives the sound.
column6: Shǔjià nǐ yǒu shénme dǎsuàn?
column7: What are your plans for the summer vacation?
column9: Summer vacation, the long break from July to August: 暑 "heat of summer" plus 假 "holiday". Used with 放 (放暑假 "begin the summer break") and 過 (過暑假). The 日 in 暑 recalls the sun, and 者 gives the sound.

column3: Midterm, the middle of a term: 期 "period" plus 中 "middle". Used as 期中考试 for the exam, and by itself for the time: 期中的时候. The pair of 期末. It is a school word, not for general use in the middle of something.
column6: Zhè cì qīzhōng, wǒ kǎo de bùcuò.
column7: This midterm, I did well.
column9: Midterm, the middle of a term: 期 "period" plus 中 "middle". Used as 期中考試 for the exam, and by itself for the time: 期中的時候. The pair of 期末. It is a school word, not for general use in the middle of something.

column3: End of the term: 期 "period" plus 末 "end". The time of the final exam: 期末考试, 期末复习. 末 is 木 "tree" with a stroke at the top, "the tip"; 本 has it at the bottom, "the root". Pair of 期中 and 期初.
column4: 期末快到了，我要好好复习。
column5: 期末快到了，我要好好複習。
column6: Qīmò kuài dào le, wǒ yào hǎohāo fùxí.
column7: The end of term is near; I must review properly.
column9: End of the term: 期 "period" plus 末 "end". The time of the final exam: 期末考試, 期末複習. 末 is 木 "tree" with a stroke at the top, "the tip"; 本 has it at the bottom, "the root". Pair of 期中 and 期初.

column3: Test paper, exam paper in the sense of the sheet with questions and answers: 试 "test" plus 卷 "paper". Verbs for it: 发试卷 "hand out", 交试卷 "hand in", 改试卷 "mark". Compare 考试 for the exam itself.
column6: Qǐng bǎ shìjuàn jiāo gěi lǎoshī.
column7: Please hand the exam paper to the teacher.
column9: Test paper, exam paper in the sense of the sheet with questions and answers: 試 "test" plus 卷 "paper". Verbs for it: 發試卷 "hand out", 交試卷 "hand in", 改試卷 "mark". Compare 考試 for the exam itself.

column3: Originally a scroll, now mostly "volume" of a book (上卷, 第三卷) and in 试卷, 考卷. As a measure word it counts volumes of a set: 一共三卷. The verb "to roll up" is a different reading, juǎn, as in 卷起来 and 蛋卷. Here juàn is the noun.
column6: Zhè tào shū yīgòng yǒu sān juàn.
column7: This set of books has three volumes in all.
column9: Originally a scroll, now mostly "volume" of a book (上卷, 第三卷) and in 試卷, 考卷. As a measure word it counts volumes of a set: 一共三卷. The verb "to roll up" is a different reading, juǎn, as in 捲起來 and 蛋卷. Here juàn is the noun.

column3: Answer, solution: 答 "reply" plus 案 "case, proposal". The answer to an exam question or a puzzle: 标准答案 "standard answer", 对答案 "check the answers". It is the thing, not the act of answering (回答 or 答). 答 uses ⺮ "bamboo", the old writing material.
column6: Zhè dào tí de dá'àn shì shénme?
column7: What is the answer to this question?
column9: Answer, solution: 答 "reply" plus 案 "case, proposal". The answer to an exam question or a puzzle: 標準答案 "standard answer", 對答案 "check the answers". It is the thing, not the act of answering (回答 or 答). 答 uses ⺮ "bamboo", the old writing material.

column3: To call the roll: 点 "to check, count" plus 名 "name". The teacher checks attendance by reading names: 老师点名. Also "to name someone": 被点名批评 "be criticized by name". It is verb plus object, so 点了名, 点过名.
column6: Lǎoshī měitiān shàngkè xiān diǎnmíng.
column7: Every day the teacher takes attendance before class.
column9: To call the roll: 點 "to check, count" plus 名 "name". The teacher checks attendance by reading names: 老師點名. Also "to name someone": 被點名批評 "be criticized by name". It is verb plus object, so 點了名, 點過名.

column3: To pass an exam or reach the standard, usually 60 points: 及 "reach" plus 格 "standard". The opposite is 不及格. It is a verb-object compound: 及不了格. Say 考试及格, and for just passing you add 了. 及 shows a hand catching a person.
column6: Zhè cì kǎoshì wǒ jígé le.
column7: I passed this exam.
column9: To pass an exam or reach the standard, usually 60 points: 及 "reach" plus 格 "standard". The opposite is 不及格. It is a verb-object compound: 及不了格. Say 考試及格, and for just passing you add 了. 及 shows a hand catching a person.

column3: To fill in the blank: 填 "fill in" plus 空 "empty space". The usual exam question is 填空题. Here 空 is kòng "empty space", not kōng "empty": 填 uses 土 "earth", hence filling a hole, and 真 for the sound. Also "to fill a vacancy".
column6: Qǐng zài kuòhào lǐ tiánkòng.
column7: Please fill in the blank inside the brackets.
column9: To fill in the blank: 填 "fill in" plus 空 "empty space". The usual exam question is 填空題. Here 空 is kòng "empty space", not kōng "empty": 填 uses 土 "earth", hence filling a hole, and 真 for the sound. Also "to fill a vacancy".

column3: To copy by hand, to copy someone else's work: 抄作业 "copy homework", 抄笔记 "copy notes". It is also "to plagiarize", and "to raid": 抄家. With 扌 "hand" and 少 as a sound hint. Differs from 复印, which is photocopying.
column6: Bùyào chāo biérén de zuòyè.
column7: Don't copy other people's homework.
column9: To copy by hand, to copy someone else's work: 抄作業 "copy homework", 抄筆記 "copy notes". It is also "to plagiarize", and "to raid": 抄家. With 扌 "hand" and 少 as a sound hint. Differs from 複印, which is photocopying.

column3: To copy out by hand: 抄 "copy" plus 写 "write". Used for copying a text for practice or record: 抄写生词 "copy out new words", 抄写三遍 "copy three times". Not for cheating; that is just 抄.
column6: Qǐng bǎ zhèxiē cí chāoxiě sān biàn.
column7: Please copy these words out three times.
column9: To copy out by hand: 抄 "copy" plus 寫 "write". Used for copying a text for practice or record: 抄寫生詞 "copy out new words", 抄寫三遍 "copy three times". Not for cheating; that is just 抄.

column3: To consult, to refer to: 参 "join" plus 考 "examine". You 参考 a book, a source or an example when forming your own view: 参考资料 "reference material". As a noun: 仅供参考 "for reference only". 参 is read cān here, not cēn or shēn.
column6: Nǐ kěyǐ cānkǎo zhè běn shū.
column7: You can consult this book.
column9: To consult, to refer to: 參 "join" plus 考 "examine". You 參考 a book, a source or an example when forming your own view: 參考資料 "reference material". As a noun: 僅供參考 "for reference only". 參 is read cān here, not cēn or shēn.

column3: To admit a candidate to a school or a job after an exam or selection: 录 "record" plus 取 "take". The school is the subject or you use 被: 他被北京大学录取了. 录取通知书 is the admission letter. Related 取 shows a hand taking an ear.
column6: Tā bèi Běijīng Dàxué lùqǔ le.
column7: He was admitted to Peking University.
column9: To admit a candidate to a school or a job after an exam or selection: 錄 "record" plus 取 "take". The school is the subject or you use 被: 他被北京大學錄取了. 錄取通知書 is the admission letter. Related 取 shows a hand taking an ear.

column3: On time, punctual: 准 "exact" plus 时 "time". Goes before the verb: 准时到, 准时开会, and as a predicate: 他很准时. 准 has 冫 beside 隹; it means "accurate", as in 准确. The pair of 按时, close in meaning.
column6: Qǐng dàjiā zhǔnshí dào.
column7: Please, everyone, be on time.
column9: On time, punctual: 準 "exact" plus 時 "time". Goes before the verb: 準時到, 準時開會, and as a predicate: 他很準時. 準 has 淮 over 十; it means "accurate", as in 準確. The pair of 按時, close in meaning.

column3: On time, by the deadline: 按 "according to" plus 时 "time". It goes before the verb and means doing something at the set time: 按时上班, 按时吃药, 按时完成. 准时 is about arriving or starting at the exact moment; 按时 is about meeting a schedule or deadline.
column6: Qǐng ànshí chī yào.
column7: Please take your medicine on time.
column9: On time, by the deadline: 按 "according to" plus 時 "time". It goes before the verb and means doing something at the set time: 按時上班, 按時吃藥, 按時完成. 準時 is about arriving or starting at the exact moment; 按時 is about meeting a schedule or deadline.

column3: To arrive late, to be late: 迟 "late" plus 到 "arrive". The one who is late is the subject: 我迟到了, 迟到十分钟. The opposite is 早到, or 准时. It is not for things that run late (a train): that is 晚点. 迟 uses 辶 "walk" for movement.
column6: Duìbuqǐ, wǒ chídào le.
column7: Sorry, I am late.
column9: To arrive late, to be late: 遲 "late" plus 到 "arrive". The one who is late is the subject: 我遲到了, 遲到十分鐘. The opposite is 早到, or 準時. It is not for things that run late (a train): that is 晚點. 遲 uses 辶 "walk" for movement.

column3: Late, delayed said of trains, planes and buses: 火车晚点了, 航班晚点. 晚 "late" plus 点 "point of time". For a person who is late use 迟到. As a different word (wǎndiǎn) it can mean a light supper, but the first sense is the one you will see.
column6: Huǒchē wǎndiǎn le èrshí fēnzhōng.
column7: The train was twenty minutes late.
column9: Late, delayed said of trains, planes and buses: 火車晚點了, 航班晚點. 晚 "late" plus 點 "point of time". For a person who is late use 遲到. As a different word (wǎndiǎn) it can mean a light supper, but the first sense is the one you will see.

column3: To postpone, to put off to a later time: 推 "push" plus 迟 "late". The thing postponed is the object, and 到 gives the new time: 推迟到下周. It can be a decision made on purpose; 延期 is similar but suits events and deadlines.
column6: Huìyì tuīchí dào xià zhōu.
column7: The meeting has been postponed to next week.
column9: To postpone, to put off to a later time: 推 "push" plus 遲 "late". The thing postponed is the object, and 到 gives the new time: 推遲到下週. It can be a decision made on purpose; 延期 is similar but suits events and deadlines.

column3: To postpone, to extend a deadline: 延 "extend" plus 期 "date, period". A verb-object compound: 延了期, 延期举行. Typical subjects are 比赛, 会议, 考试, 签证 and deadlines. Often due to a reason: 因为…延期. Close to 推迟.
column6: Bǐsài yīnwèi xià yǔ yánqī le.
column7: The match was postponed because of rain.
column9: To postpone, to extend a deadline: 延 "extend" plus 期 "date, period". A verb-object compound: 延了期, 延期舉行. Typical subjects are 比賽, 會議, 考試, 簽證 and deadlines. Often due to a reason: 因為…延期. Close to 推遲.

column3: To lengthen, to extend in time or length: 延 "extend" plus 长 "long". You 延长 a visit, a meeting, a visa or a road: 延长半小时. The result is that something lasts longer or runs farther. Compare 延期, which moves a date later.
column6: Huìyì yáncháng le bàn xiǎoshí.
column7: The meeting was extended by half an hour.
column9: To lengthen, to extend in time or length: 延 "extend" plus 長 "long". You 延長 a visit, a meeting, a visa or a road: 延長半小時. The result is that something lasts longer or runs farther. Compare 延期, which moves a date later.

column3: Temporary, at short notice: 临 "be near" plus 时 "time". As an adverb before a verb: 临时有事 "something came up at the last moment", 临时决定. As an attribute: 临时工 "temporary worker", 临时住所. The thing was not planned in advance.
column6: Wǒ línshí yǒu shì, bù néng qù le.
column7: Something came up and I cannot go.
column9: Temporary, at short notice: 臨 "be near" plus 時 "time". As an adverb before a verb: 臨時有事 "something came up at the last moment", 臨時決定. As an attribute: 臨時工 "temporary worker", 臨時住所. The thing was not planned in advance.

column3: In advance, beforehand: 事 "matter" plus 先 "first". It goes before the verb: 事先通知, 事先准备, 事先告诉. It stresses that something was done before the event. The same idea as 提前, but 事先 is about telling or preparing, and 提前 more about moving a time earlier.
column6: Yǒu shì qǐng shìxiān gàosu wǒ.
column7: If something comes up, tell me beforehand.
column9: In advance, beforehand: 事 "matter" plus 先 "first". It goes before the verb: 事先通知, 事先準備, 事先告訴. It stresses that something was done before the event. The same idea as 提前, but 事先 is about telling or preparing, and 提前 more about moving a time earlier.

column3: About to, soon to: 即 "immediately" plus 将 "will". Written and formal, always before a verb and often with 了: 即将出发, 即将开始. It suits announcements and news. In speech, 快要 or 就要 are normal. 即 shows a person kneeling over food, "to approach".
column6: Fēijī jíjiāng qǐfēi.
column7: The plane is about to take off.
column9: About to, soon to: 即 "immediately" plus 將 "will". Written and formal, always before a verb and often with 了: 即將出發, 即將開始. It suits announcements and news. In speech, 快要 or 就要 are normal. 即 shows a person kneeling over food, "to approach".

column3: Once, before in a written or formal style: 我曾在北京住过. It marks a past experience, often with 过: 曾经 is the fuller, more common form. 曾 is also a surname. Read céng here; as a surname it is Zēng.
column6: Wǒ céng zài Běijīng zhù guo liǎng nián.
column7: I once lived in Beijing for two years.
column9: Once, before in a written or formal style: 我曾在北京住過. It marks a past experience, often with 過: 曾經 is the fuller, more common form. 曾 is also a surname. Read céng here; as a surname it is Zēng.

column3: Still, as before: 依 "rely on" plus 然 "so". It goes before the verb and says that nothing has changed in spite of time or events: 依然如故, 他依然很忙. More written than 还是 or 仍然. Often follows a time phrase.
column4: 十年过去了，他依然没变。
column5: 十年過去了，他依然沒變。
column6: Shí nián guòqù le, tā yīrán méi biàn.
column7: Ten years have passed and he is still the same.
column9: Still, as before: 依 "rely on" plus 然 "so". It goes before the verb and says that nothing has changed in spite of time or events: 依然如故, 他依然很忙. More written than 還是 or 仍然. Often follows a time phrase.

column3: Vocabulary: 词 "word" plus 汇 "gather together". All the words of a language or of a person: 词汇丰富, 扩大词汇. It is a collective, so it takes no number: you do not count 词汇. For a single word say 词 or 单词.
column6: Tā de cíhuì hěn fēngfù.
column7: His vocabulary is very rich.
column9: Vocabulary: 詞 "word" plus 彙 "gather together". All the words of a language or of a person: 詞彙豐富, 擴大詞彙. It is a collective, so it takes no number: you do not count 詞彙. For a single word say 詞 or 單詞.

column3: Grammar: 语 "language" plus 法 "rule, method". Typical use: 汉语语法, 语法错误, 学语法. 法 has 氵 "water" and 去. The word is only the grammar, not the language itself (语言).
column6: Hànyǔ yǔfǎ bù tài nán.
column7: Chinese grammar is not too hard.
column9: Grammar: 語 "language" plus 法 "rule, method". Typical use: 漢語語法, 語法錯誤, 學語法. 法 has 氵 "water" and 去. The word is only the grammar, not the language itself (語言).

column3: Pronunciation, speech sounds: 语 "speech" plus 音 "sound". The sound system of a language or the way you pronounce: 语音标准. In apps it is also a voice message: 语音消息, 发语音. 音 is 立 over 日, as in 意 "idea".
column6: Tā de yǔyīn hěn biāozhǔn.
column7: His pronunciation is very standard.
column9: Pronunciation, speech sounds: 語 "speech" plus 音 "sound". The sound system of a language or the way you pronounce: 語音標準. In apps it is also a voice message: 語音消息, 發語音. 音 is 立 over 日, as in 意 "idea".

column3: Spoken language: 口 "mouth" plus 语 "language". Opposed to written language, 书面语. Used for language learning: 英语口语, 口语考试, 练习口语. Also means "colloquial speech" as a style.
column6: Tā de Yīngyǔ kǒuyǔ hěn hǎo.
column7: Her spoken English is very good.
column9: Spoken language: 口 "mouth" plus 語 "language". Opposed to written language, 書面語. Used for language learning: 英語口語, 口語考試, 練習口語. Also means "colloquial speech" as a style.

column3: Letter of an alphabet: 字 "character" plus 母 "mother". The "mother" part means a basic unit from which others come. Said of the Latin alphabet (拼音字母) and any alphabet: 二十六个字母. A Chinese character is a 字, not a 字母.
column6: Yīngyǔ yǒu èrshíliù ge zìmǔ.
column7: English has twenty-six letters.
column9: Letter of an alphabet: 字 "character" plus 母 "mother". The "mother" part means a basic unit from which others come. Said of the Latin alphabet (拼音字母) and any alphabet: 二十六個字母. A Chinese character is a 字, not a 字母.

column3: Parentheses, brackets: 括 "to enclose" plus 号 "mark". Used on forms and tests: 括号里 "inside the brackets", 填在括号里. 括 has 扌 "hand" and 舌 as its sound. The mark itself is 号, as in 符号 and 号码.
column6: Qǐng bǎ dá'àn xiě zài kuòhào lǐ.
column7: Please write the answer in the brackets.
column9: Parentheses, brackets: 括 "to enclose" plus 號 "mark". Used on forms and tests: 括號裡 "inside the brackets", 填在括號裡. 括 has 扌 "hand" and 舌 as its sound. The mark itself is 號, as in 符號 and 號碼.

column3: Symbol, sign, mark: 符 "token, sign" plus 号 "mark". Used for punctuation, math, music and keyboard signs: 标点符号 "punctuation", 符号表. 符 has ⺮ "bamboo" on top, because tokens were once made of bamboo slips, and 付 as its sound.
column6: Zhège fúhào shì shénme yìsi?
column7: What does this symbol mean?
column9: Symbol, sign, mark: 符 "token, sign" plus 號 "mark". Used for punctuation, math, music and keyboard signs: 標點符號 "punctuation", 符號表. 符 has ⺮ "bamboo" on top, because tokens were once made of bamboo slips, and 付 as its sound.

column3: Sign, symbol, logo: 标 "mark" plus 志 "sign". A thing that shows a status or that stands for something: 交通标志 "traffic sign", 公司的标志 "the company logo". As a verb it means to mark or signal an event: 标志着新阶段.
column4: 这个标志表示禁止停车。
column5: 這個標誌表示禁止停車。
column6: Zhège biāozhì biǎoshì jìnzhǐ tíngchē.
column7: This sign means no parking.
column9: Sign, symbol, logo: 標 "mark" plus 誌 "sign". A thing that shows a status or that stands for something: 交通標誌 "traffic sign", 公司的標誌 "the company logo". As a verb it means to mark or signal an event: 標誌著新階段.

column3: To read with attention: 阅 "look over" plus 读 "read". Written and formal; it fits reading as a skill or habit: 阅读理解 "reading comprehension", 阅读书籍. In speech, 看书 or 读书 are usual. 阅 has 门 and 兑.
column4: 我每天晚上阅读半小时。
column5: 我每天晚上閱讀半小時。
column6: Wǒ měitiān wǎnshang yuèdú bàn xiǎoshí.
column7: Every evening I read for half an hour.
column9: To read with attention: 閱 "look over" plus 讀 "read". Written and formal; it fits reading as a skill or habit: 閱讀理解 "reading comprehension", 閱讀書籍. In speech, 看書 or 讀書 are usual. 閱 has 門 and 兌.

column3: To edit, to compile, to compose, to make up: 编书 "compile a book", 编故事 "make up a story", 编程序 "write a program". It also means to weave: 编辫子. 编 has 纟 "thread" for the weaving sense, which grew into putting a text together. Common in 编辑 "editor".
column6: Tā biān le yī běn cídiǎn.
column7: He compiled a dictionary.
column9: To edit, to compile, to compose, to make up: 編書 "compile a book", 編故事 "make up a story", 編程序 "write a program". It also means to weave: 編辮子. 編 has 糹 "thread" for the weaving sense, which grew into putting a text together. Common in 編輯 "editor".

column3: To translate or interpret, and "translator": 翻 "turn over" plus 译 "translate". As a verb, with 成 for the target: 翻译成英语. As a noun, a person: 他是翻译. It works for writing and speech alike.
column4: 请把这句话翻译成英语。
column5: 請把這句話翻譯成英語。
column6: Qǐng bǎ zhè jù huà fānyì chéng Yīngyǔ.
column7: Please translate this sentence into English.
column9: To translate or interpret, and "translator": 翻 "turn over" plus 譯 "translate". As a verb, with 成 for the target: 翻譯成英語. As a noun, a person: 他是翻譯. It works for writing and speech alike.

column3: To turn over, to flip: 翻页 "turn the page", 翻身 "turn over in bed", 翻书 "look through a book". Also "to cross" (翻山) and "to translate" (翻译). 翻 has 羽 "wings", from the flap of a wing, and 番 for sound.
column6: Qǐng fān dào dì shí yè.
column7: Please turn to page ten.
column9: To turn over, to flip: 翻頁 "turn the page", 翻身 "turn over in bed", 翻書 "look through a book". Also "to cross" (翻山) and "to translate" (翻譯). 翻 has 羽 "wings", from the flap of a wing, and 番 for sound.

column3: To describe in words, in an organized way: 描 "trace" plus 述 "relate". The object is what happened or what something is like: 描述情况, 描述过程. It is neutral and fits reports and tests. The 扌 in 描 hints at drawing by hand.
column4: 请描述一下你看到的情况。
column5: 請描述一下你看到的情況。
column6: Qǐng miáoshù yīxià nǐ kàndào de qíngkuàng.
column7: Please describe what you saw.
column9: To describe in words, in an organized way: 描 "trace" plus 述 "relate". The object is what happened or what something is like: 描述情況, 描述過程. It is neutral and fits reports and tests. The 扌 in 描 hints at drawing by hand.

column3: To depict, to portray in writing: 描 "trace" plus 写 "write". Used about literature and art, whose author portrays a person, place or feeling: 描写人物, 描写景色. Where 描述 reports facts, 描写 paints a picture.
column4: 这篇文章描写了乡村的生活。
column5: 這篇文章描寫了鄉村的生活。
column6: Zhè piān wénzhāng miáoxiě le xiāngcūn de shēnghuó.
column7: This article portrays life in the countryside.
column9: To depict, to portray in writing: 描 "trace" plus 寫 "write". Used about literature and art, whose author portrays a person, place or feeling: 描寫人物, 描寫景色. Where 描述 reports facts, 描寫 paints a picture.

column3: To describe by comparison or with a word: 形 "form" plus 容 "appearance". The pattern 用…形容 "describe with…": 无法形容 "can't be described", 形容词 "adjective". You often use it for something that is hard to say.
column4: 这个词可以用来形容天气。
column5: 這個詞可以用來形容天氣。
column6: Zhège cí kěyǐ yòng lái xíngróng tiānqì.
column7: This word can be used to describe the weather.
column9: To describe by comparison or with a word: 形 "form" plus 容 "appearance". The pattern 用…形容 "describe with…": 無法形容 "can't be described", 形容詞 "adjective". You often use it for something that is hard to say.

column3: To explain: 解 "untie, solve" plus 释 "clarify". You 解释 a word, a reason or an action: 解释原因, 向他解释. It can mean making an excuse: 不用解释了. Both characters share the picture of loosening something. 解 shows a knife taking a horn off an ox.
column6: Qǐng nǐ jiěshì yīxià zhège cí.
column7: Please explain this word.
column9: To explain: 解 "untie, solve" plus 釋 "clarify". You 解釋 a word, a reason or an action: 解釋原因, 向他解釋. It can mean making an excuse: 不用解釋了. Both characters share the picture of loosening something. 解 shows a knife taking a horn off an ox.

column3: Poem, poetry: 唐诗 "Tang poems", 写诗, 读诗, and the measure word 首: 一首诗. The 讠 on the left is the speech radical, since poems were recited, and 寺 gives the sound shi. Same sound part as 时 and 等.
column6: Wǒ zuì xǐhuan zhè shǒu shī.
column7: This poem is my favorite.
column9: Poem, poetry: 唐詩 "Tang poems", 寫詩, 讀詩, and the measure word 首: 一首詩. The 言 on the left is the speech radical, since poems were recited, and 寺 gives the sound shi. Same sound part as 時 and 等.

column3: Poet: 诗 "poem" plus 人 "person". Said of famous poets in history or today: 唐代诗人, 著名诗人. It does not mean someone who just writes a poem now and then. 李白 and 杜甫 are the most famous Tang 诗人.
column6: Lǐ Bái shì yǒumíng de shīrén.
column7: Li Bai is a famous poet.
column9: Poet: 詩 "poem" plus 人 "person". Said of famous poets in history or today: 唐代詩人, 著名詩人. It does not mean someone who just writes a poem now and then. 李白 and 杜甫 are the most famous Tang 詩人.

column3: Myth, mythology: 神 "god" plus 话 "story". Traditional tales about gods and the start of the world: 希腊神话, 中国神话. Also used for something unbelievable: 这是个神话. 神 has 礻 "spirit" and 申, which started as a lightning bolt.
column6: Zhè shì yī ge gǔlǎo de shénhuà.
column7: This is an ancient myth.
column9: Myth, mythology: 神 "god" plus 話 "story". Traditional tales about gods and the start of the world: 希臘神話, 中國神話. Also used for something unbelievable: 這是個神話. 神 has 礻 "spirit" and 申, which started as a lightning bolt.

column3: Fairy tale: 童 "child" plus 话 "story". Stories for children: 童话故事, 安徒生童话. 童 recalls a standing figure with 立 and 里. Compared to 神话, which are the old tales of gods, 童话 is an invented children's story.
column4: 她给女儿讲了一个童话。
column5: 她給女兒講了一個童話。
column6: Tā gěi nǚ'ér jiǎng le yī ge tónghuà.
column7: She told her daughter a fairy tale.
column9: Fairy tale: 童 "child" plus 話 "story". Stories for children: 童話故事, 安徒生童話. 童 recalls a standing figure with 立 and 里. Compared to 神話, which are the old tales of gods, 童話 is an invented children's story.

column3: Written work, book: 著 "to write" plus 作 "work". A scholarly or literary work with an author: 一部著作, 学术著作. The phrase 著作等身 means "writings as tall as the author". Formal. Note 著 here is zhù, not zhe or zháo.
column6: Zhè wèi zuòjiā yǒu hěn duō zhùzuò.
column7: This writer has produced many works.
column9: Written work, book: 著 "to write" plus 作 "work". A scholarly or literary work with an author: 一部著作, 學術著作. The phrase 著作等身 means "writings as tall as the author". Formal. Note 著 here is zhù, not zhe or zháo.

column3: Famous, well known: 著 "noticeable" plus 名 "name". Before a noun, with 的: 著名的作家, 著名景点. It is more formal than 有名. 著 is read zhù here.
column4: 北京是著名的旅游城市。
column5: 北京是著名的旅遊城市。
column6: Běijīng shì zhùmíng de lǚyóu chéngshì.
column7: Beijing is a famous tourist city.
column9: Famous, well known: 著 "noticeable" plus 名 "name". Before a noun, with 的: 著名的作家, 著名景點. It is more formal than 有名. 著 is read zhù here.

column3: Classic, a classic work: 经 "classics" plus 典 "canon". As a noun, a work that lasts: 这部电影是经典. As an adjective: 经典作品, 经典歌曲. In the old sense, the Confucian classics. 典 shows a book on a table.
column4: 这部电影已经成为经典。
column5: 這部電影已經成為經典。
column6: Zhè bù diànyǐng yǐjīng chéngwéi jīngdiǎn.
column7: This film has become a classic.
column9: Classic, a classic work: 經 "classics" plus 典 "canon". As a noun, a work that lasts: 這部電影是經典. As an adjective: 經典作品, 經典歌曲. In the old sense, the Confucian classics. 典 shows a book on a table.

column3: History: 历 "pass through" plus 史 "record". Used for the past of a country or a thing: 中国历史, 历史老师, 有两千年的历史. The 史 once showed a hand holding a brush for recording. Not "story": for that use 故事.
column4: 这座城市有两千年的历史。
column5: 這座城市有兩千年的歷史。
column6: Zhè zuò chéngshì yǒu liǎng qiān nián de lìshǐ.
column7: This city has a history of two thousand years.
column9: History: 歷 "pass through" plus 史 "record". Used for the past of a country or a thing: 中國歷史, 歷史老師, 有兩千年的歷史. The 史 once showed a hand holding a brush for recording. Not "story": for that use 故事.

column3: Common Era, AD: 公 "public" plus 元 "first year". Used before a year: 公元2000年, and 公元前 for BC. The numbers go after, unlike English: 公元前221年. Written and school-textbook style; in speech people just say the year.
column4: 这座塔建于公元七世纪。
column5: 這座塔建於公元七世紀。
column6: Zhè zuò tǎ jiànyú gōngyuán qī shìjì.
column7: This pagoda was built in the seventh century AD.
column9: Common Era, AD: 公 "public" plus 元 "first year". Used before a year: 公元2000年, and 公元前 for BC. The numbers go after, unlike English: 公元前221年. Written and school-textbook style; in speech people just say the year.

column3: Modern times in the historical sense, between the old and the present: 近 "near" plus 代 "age". In Chinese history it means from the Opium War (1840) to about 1919. It comes before 现代 "the contemporary period". Used as 近代史.
column6: Zhè zuò lóu shì jìndài jiànzào de.
column7: This building was built in modern times.
column9: Modern times in the historical sense, between the old and the present: 近 "near" plus 代 "age". In Chinese history it means from the Opium War (1840) to about 1919. It comes before 現代 "the contemporary period". Used as 近代史.

column3: Tradition, traditional: 传 "pass on" plus 统 "line, system". As a noun: 保持传统. As an adjective before a noun: 传统文化, 传统节日 "traditional festival". Used about customs, foods, medicine, clothes. 传 is 亻 with 专.
column4: 春节是中国的传统节日。
column5: 春節是中國的傳統節日。
column6: Chūnjié shì Zhōngguó de chuántǒng jiérì.
column7: The Spring Festival is a traditional Chinese holiday.
column9: Tradition, traditional: 傳 "pass on" plus 統 "line, system". As a noun: 保持傳統. As an adjective before a noun: 傳統文化, 傳統節日 "traditional festival". Used about customs, foods, medicine, clothes. 傳 is 亻 with 專.

column3: To record in writing, a record: 记 "note down" plus 载 "carry, write". Subject is a book or document: 书上记载着…. Also a noun: 历史记载. Here 载 is zǎi, not zài. Compare 记录, a record of data.
column6: Shū lǐ jìzǎi le hěn duō gùshi.
column7: The book records many stories.
column9: To record in writing, a record: 記 "note down" plus 載 "carry, write". Subject is a book or document: 書上記載著…. Also a noun: 歷史記載. Here 載 is zǎi, not zài. Compare 記錄, a record of data.

column3: To spread, to be handed down: 流 "flow" plus 传 "pass on". The subject is a tale, a custom or a song that goes from person to person and generation to generation: 流传了几百年, 广为流传 "widely known". 流 is water plus a phonetic part.
column4: 这个故事流传了几百年。
column5: 這個故事流傳了幾百年。
column6: Zhège gùshi liúchuán le jǐ bǎi nián.
column7: This story has been passed down for hundreds of years.
column9: To spread, to be handed down: 流 "flow" plus 傳 "pass on". The subject is a tale, a custom or a song that goes from person to person and generation to generation: 流傳了幾百年, 廣為流傳 "widely known". 流 is water plus a phonetic part.

column3: To continue, to go on: 延 "extend" plus 续 "continue". Used for things that last in time and carry on from an earlier time: 延续到今天, 延续传统. Something that was started goes on, usually with a time word or place after 到.
column4: 这种习惯一直延续到今天。
column5: 這種習慣一直延續到今天。
column6: Zhè zhǒng xíguàn yīzhí yánxù dào jīntiān.
column7: This custom has continued to this day.
column9: To continue, to go on: 延 "extend" plus 續 "continue". Used for things that last in time and carry on from an earlier time: 延續到今天, 延續傳統. Something that was started goes on, usually with a time word or place after 到.

column3: Network, and in daily speech "the internet": 网 "net" plus 络 "web, network". Used for 网络游戏, 网络安全, 网络不好 "the connection is bad", 上网络. 网 is a picture of a net, and 络 has 纟 "thread". Taiwan says 网路 instead.
column6: Xiànzài de wǎngluò hěn fāngbiàn.
column7: Today's internet is very convenient.
column9: Network, and in daily speech "the internet": 網 "net" plus 絡 "web, network". Used for 網絡遊戲, 網絡安全, 網絡不好 "the connection is bad", 上網絡. 網 is a picture of a net, and 絡 has 糹 "thread". Taiwan says 網路 instead.

column3: Web address, URL: 网 "web" plus 址 "site, location". People give it to others to type: 把网址发给我 "send me the address". 址 has 土 "earth" and 止 for sound, and appears in 地址 "street address" too.
column6: Qǐng gàosu wǒ nǐ de wǎngzhǐ.
column7: Please tell me your web address.
column9: Web address, URL: 網 "web" plus 址 "site, location". People give it to others to type: 把網址發給我 "send me the address". 址 has 土 "earth" and 止 for sound, and appears in 地址 "street address" too.

column3: WeChat, the messaging app of Tencent: 微 "tiny" plus 信 "message". It is also the word for a message sent on it and for the account: 发微信, 微信号, 微信支付. 信 is 亻 and 言 "words", "a person's word". Say it as a name; no measure word is needed.
column6: Wǒmen yòng Wēixìn liáotiān ba.
column7: Let's chat on WeChat.
column9: WeChat, the messaging app of Tencent: 微 "tiny" plus 信 "message". It is also the word for a message sent on it and for the account: 發微信, 微信號, 微信支付. 信 is 亻 and 言 "words", "a person's word". Say it as a name; no measure word is needed.

column3: To download: 下 "down" plus 载 "carry". The object is the thing downloaded: 下载软件, 下载音乐. The reading of 载 here is zǎi; as a plain "to carry", zài. The opposite is 上传. 载 has the 车 "cart" radical because it first meant to load a vehicle.
column4: 我在网上下载了一首歌。
column5: 我在網上下載了一首歌。
column6: Wǒ zài wǎng shàng xiàzài le yī shǒu gē.
column7: I downloaded a song online.
column9: To download: 下 "down" plus 載 "carry". The object is the thing downloaded: 下載軟件, 下載音樂. The reading of 載 here is zǎi; as a plain "to carry", zài. The opposite is 上傳. 載 has the 車 "cart" radical because it first meant to load a vehicle.

column3: To log in: 登 "go up" plus 录 "record". The object is the account or website: 登录账号, 登录网站. Taiwan often says 登入 instead. The reverse is 退出 or 注销. 登 shows two feet 癶 climbing, which suits "going up" to a site.
column6: Qǐng xiān dēnglù nǐ de zhànghào.
column7: Please log in to your account first.
column9: To log in: 登 "go up" plus 錄 "record". The object is the account or website: 登錄帳號, 登錄網站. Taiwan often says 登入 instead. The reverse is 退出 or 註銷. 登 shows two feet 癶 climbing, which suits "going up" to a site.

column3: Data: 数 "number" plus 据 "evidence". Collections of figures: 大数据 "big data", 数据库 "database", 分析数据. A collective noun without a measure word. 据 has 扌 "hand" and 居 for the sound; 根据 "according to" has the same 据.
column6: Zhèxiē shùjù hěn zhòngyào.
column7: These data are very important.
column9: Data: 數 "number" plus 據 "evidence". Collections of figures: 大數據 "big data", 數據庫 "database", 分析數據. A collective noun without a measure word. 據 has 扌 "hand" and 豦 for the sound; 根據 "according to" has the same 據.

column3: Digital: 数 "number" plus 码 "code". Before a noun: 数码相机 "digital camera", 数码产品 "digital products". Used for consumer electronics in mainland China; Taiwan prefers 数位. Also the number itself in some uses.
column6: Tā xǐhuan mǎi shùmǎ chǎnpǐn.
column7: He likes to buy digital gadgets.
column9: Digital: 數 "number" plus 碼 "code". Before a noun: 數碼相機 "digital camera", 數碼產品 "digital products". Used for consumer electronics in mainland China; Taiwan prefers 數位. Also the number itself in some uses.

column3: To charge a battery: 充 "fill" plus 电 "electricity". Verb-object, so 充满电, 充了电, 充一会儿电. The figurative sense is to recharge by learning: 去学校充电. 电 has 曰 and a hook.
column6: Shǒujī méi diàn le, wǒ yào chōngdiàn.
column7: My phone is out of battery, I need to charge it.
column9: To charge a battery: 充 "fill" plus 電 "electricity". Verb-object, so 充滿電, 充了電, 充一會兒電. The figurative sense is to recharge by learning: 去學校充電. 電 has 雨 on top, with 曰 and a hook below.

column3: Charger: 充电 plus 器 "device". The unit that you plug in: 手机充电器. 器 shows four mouths around a 犬 "dog", a set of vessels; as an ending it makes a device word, as in 计算器 "calculator". A cord alone is 充电线.
column6: Nǐ yǒu shǒujī chōngdiànqì ma?
column7: Do you have a phone charger?
column9: Charger: 充電 plus 器 "device". The unit that you plug in: 手機充電器. 器 shows four mouths around a 犬 "dog", a set of vessels; as an ending it makes a device word, as in 計算器 "calculator". A cord alone is 充電線.

column3: Headphones, earphones: 耳 "ear" plus 机 "machine". 戴耳机 "wear", 插耳机 "plug in". 耳 is a picture of an ear.
column6: Wǒ dàizhe ěrjī tīng yīnyuè.
column7: I am listening to music with headphones on.
column9: Headphones, earphones: 耳 "ear" plus 機 "machine". 戴耳機 "wear", 插耳機 "plug in". 耳 is a picture of an ear.

column3: Settings, to set up: 设 "establish" plus 置 "place". As a noun, the settings menu in an app: 在设置里. As a verb: 设置密码 "set a password". 置 has 罒 "net" over 直, and appears in 位置 "position". In Taiwan both are used, 设定 more often.
column4: 你可以在设置里改语言。
column5: 你可以在設置裡改語言。
column6: Nǐ kěyǐ zài shèzhì lǐ gǎi yǔyán.
column7: You can change the language in the settings.
column9: Settings, to set up: 設 "establish" plus 置 "place". As a noun, the settings menu in an app: 在設置裡. As a verb: 設置密碼 "set a password". 置 has 罒 "net" over 直, and appears in 位置 "position". In Taiwan both are used, 設定 more often.

column3: System: 系 "tie, connect" plus 统 "line, whole". Used for computers (操作系统), organizations (教育系统) and the body (消化系统). 系 is also the word for a university department. Here it is read xì; in 联系, also xì.
column6: Diànnǎo de xìtǒng xūyào gēngxīn.
column7: The computer's system needs an update.
column9: System: 系 "tie, connect" plus 統 "line, whole". Used for computers (操作系統), organizations (教育系統) and the body (消化系統). 系 is also the word for a university department. Here it is read xì; in 聯繫, also xì.

column3: Procedure, computer program: 程 "course" plus 序 "order". As a program: 写程序, 安装程序, 程序员 "programmer". As a procedure: 手续程序. The Taiwan word for a program is more often 程式. 程 has 禾 "grain", from the old use of measuring.
column6: Zhège chéngxù hěn hǎoyòng.
column7: This program is very easy to use.
column9: Procedure, computer program: 程 "course" plus 序 "order". As a program: 寫程序, 安裝程序, 程序員 "programmer". As a procedure: 手續程序. The Taiwan word for a program is more often 程式. 程 has 禾 "grain", from the old use of measuring.

column3: To operate, to handle a machine or program: 操 "hold" plus 作 "do". Typically a tool or system is the object: 操作电脑, 操作简单 "easy to operate". 操作系统 is "operating system". 操 has 扌 "hand" and 喿 for sound.
column6: Zhè tái jīqì hěn róngyì cāozuò.
column7: This machine is very easy to operate.
column9: To operate, to handle a machine or program: 操 "hold" plus 作 "do". Typically a tool or system is the object: 操作電腦, 操作簡單 "easy to operate". 操作系統 is "operating system". 操 has 扌 "hand" and 喿 for sound.

column3: To copy, to duplicate: 复 "repeat" plus 制 "make". On a computer: 复制和粘贴 "copy and paste". It can also mean cloning. Different from 抄, which means to copy by hand.
column6: Nǐ kěyǐ fùzhì zhè duàn huà.
column7: You can copy this passage.
column9: To copy, to duplicate: 複 "repeat" plus 製 "make". On a computer: 複製和粘貼 "copy and paste". It can also mean cloning. Different from 抄, which means to copy by hand.

column3: To reply to a message or mail: 回 "return" plus 复 "answer". Used for texts, e-mails and comments: 回复邮件, 请尽快回复. The same word 回复 can also be "to recover", in written style. In speech, 回 or 回信 are enough.
column6: Wǒ hái méi huífù tā de yóujiàn.
column7: I have not yet replied to his e-mail.
column9: To reply to a message or mail: 回 "return" plus 復 "answer". Used for texts, e-mails and comments: 回復郵件, 請盡快回復. The same word 回復 can also be "to recover", in written style. In speech, 回 or 回信 are enough.

column3: Smart, intelligent for machines: 智 "wise" plus 能 "ability". Before a noun: 智能手机 "smartphone", 智能家居 "smart home". Also "intelligence" in 人工智能 "artificial intelligence". Not said of people; use 聪明.
column4: 现在人人都有智能手机。
column5: 現在人人都有智能手機。
column6: Xiànzài rénrén dōu yǒu zhìnéng shǒujī.
column7: Everyone has a smartphone now.
column9: Smart, intelligent for machines: 智 "wise" plus 能 "ability". Before a noun: 智能手機 "smartphone", 智能家居 "smart home". Also "intelligence" in 人工智能 "artificial intelligence". Not said of people; use 聰明.

column3: Compact disc, CD or DVD: 光 "light" plus 盘 "disc". A disc read by light. The measure word is 张. 盘 also means "plate", so 光盘 can look like "light plate". The campaign 光盘行动 means "clean your plate". 盘 has 皿 "dish".
column6: Zhè zhāng guāngpán shì xīn mǎi de.
column7: This CD is newly bought.
column9: Compact disc, CD or DVD: 光 "light" plus 盤 "disc". A disc read by light. The measure word is 張. 盤 also means "plate", so 光盤 can look like "light plate". The campaign 光盤行動 means "clean your plate". 盤 has 皿 "dish".

column3: Record, album: 唱 "sing" plus 片 "flat piece". It covers vinyl records and, by extension, music CDs: 听唱片, 一张唱片. 片 is half of a tree trunk, a "slice", and in 唱片 it names the disc. 唱 has 口 for the mouth.
column6: Tā shōují le hěn duō jiù chàngpiàn.
column7: He has collected many old records.
column9: Record, album: 唱 "sing" plus 片 "flat piece". It covers vinyl records and, by extension, music CDs: 聽唱片, 一張唱片. 片 is half of a tree trunk, a "slice", and in 唱片 it names the disc. 唱 has 口 for the mouth.

column3: Password, secret code: 密 "secret" plus 码 "code". Common phrases: 输入密码, 设置密码, 忘记密码. 密 has 宀 "roof" and 山, with 宓 giving sound, and appears in 秘密 "secret" too. Also means a cipher.
column6: Qǐng shūrù nǐ de mìmǎ.
column7: Please enter your password.
column9: Password, secret code: 密 "secret" plus 碼 "code". Common phrases: 輸入密碼, 設置密碼, 忘記密碼. 密 has 宀 "roof" and 山, with 宓 giving sound, and appears in 秘密 "secret" too. Also means a cipher.

column3: Number in a series, such as a phone or ID number: 号 "number" plus 码 "numeral". 手机号码 "mobile number", 电话号码, 号码牌. For quantity, use 数字 or 数. 码 has 石 and 马, with 马 for sound.
column6: Nǐ de shǒujī hàomǎ shì duōshao?
column7: What is your mobile number?
column9: Number in a series, such as a phone or ID number: 號 "number" plus 碼 "numeral". 手機號碼 "mobile number", 電話號碼, 號碼牌. For quantity, use 數字 or 數. 碼 has 石 and 馬, with 馬 for sound.

column3: To test, to detect: 检 "inspect" plus 测 "measure". Used for tests of health, water, quality and equipment: 检测结果 "the test result", 核酸检测. A formal word for a check done with tools or a lab.
column6: Tā qù yīyuàn zuò le jiǎncè.
column7: He went to the hospital for a test.
column9: To test, to detect: 檢 "inspect" plus 測 "measure". Used for tests of health, water, quality and equipment: 檢測結果 "the test result", 核酸檢測. A formal word for a check done with tools or a lab.

column3: Sports meet, games: 运动 "sports" plus 会 "gathering". The school or company sports day: 开运动会, 校运动会. Includes many events at once. 会 here means a gathering, as in 晚会; it has the same 会 as in 开会 "to hold a meeting".
column6: Xuéxiào xià zhōu kāi yùndònghuì.
column7: The school holds its sports meet next week.
column9: Sports meet, games: 運動 "sports" plus 會 "gathering". The school or company sports day: 開運動會, 校運動會. Includes many events at once. 會 here means a gathering, as in 晚會; it has the same 會 as in 開會 "to hold a meeting".

column3: The Asian Games: 亚 for Asia, 运动会 for games, shortened to 亚运会. Held every four years: 杭州亚运会. 亚 is a short form of 亚洲 "Asia". The Olympic Games are 奥运会 and the same pattern.
column4: 亚运会每四年举行一次。
column5: 亞運會每四年舉行一次。
column6: Yàyùnhuì měi sì nián jǔxíng yī cì.
column7: The Asian Games are held every four years.
column9: The Asian Games: 亞 for Asia, 運動會 for games, shortened to 亞運會. Held every four years: 杭州亞運會. 亞 is a short form of 亞洲 "Asia". The Olympic Games are 奧運會 and the same pattern.

column3: Athlete: 运动 "sports" plus 员 "member". Add the sport before: 游泳运动员, 足球运动员. The ending 员 makes people by job, as in 演员 "actor" and 服务员 "waiter". 员 is made of 口 over 贝, a shell for money, an old sign for staff.
column6: Tā shì yī míng yóuyǒng yùndòngyuán.
column7: He is a swimmer.
column9: Athlete: 運動 "sports" plus 員 "member". Add the sport before: 游泳運動員, 足球運動員. The ending 員 makes people by job, as in 演員 "actor" and 服務員 "waiter". 員 is made of 口 over 貝, a shell for money, an old sign for staff.

column3: Score of a match: 比 "compare" plus 分 "points". It is said as 二比一, and asked as 比分是多少?. The 比 here is the same as in "A 比 B": a "versus". 比 is two 匕 side by side.
column6: Xiànzài de bǐfēn shì èr bǐ yī.
column7: The score is now two to one.
column9: Score of a match: 比 "compare" plus 分 "points". It is said as 二比一, and asked as 比分是多少?. The 比 here is the same as in "A 比 B": a "versus". 比 is two 匕 side by side.

column3: Gymnastics, physical exercises: 体 "body" plus 操 "exercise". Can mean the sport (体操比赛) or the short drill done together, as 广播体操 "radio gymnastics" done in schools. 操 is also a verb, "to drill, to handle", as in 操作.
column6: Tā cóng xiǎo liàn tǐcāo.
column7: She has trained in gymnastics since she was little.
column9: Gymnastics, physical exercises: 體 "body" plus 操 "exercise". Can mean the sport (體操比賽) or the short drill done together, as 廣播體操 "radio gymnastics" done in schools. 操 is also a verb, "to drill, to handle", as in 操作.

column3: To keep fit, to work out: 健 "healthy" plus 身 "body". Verb-object: 去健身, 健身房 "gym". The sports of 健身 are done for health and shape, not competition. 健 combines 亻 with 建 for sound.
column6: Tā měitiān zǎoshang jiànshēn.
column7: He works out every morning.
column9: To keep fit, to work out: 健 "healthy" plus 身 "body". Verb-object: 去健身, 健身房 "gym". The sports of 健身 are done for health and shape, not competition. 健 combines 亻 with 建 for sound.

column3: To exercise, to train: 锻 "forge metal" plus 炼 "refine". Both pieces come from metalworking, so the word means toughening your body or skills: 锻炼身体, 锻炼能力. The second syllable is a falling tone: liàn. More general than 健身.
column4: 每天锻炼身体对健康有好处。
column5: 每天鍛鍊身體對健康有好處。
column6: Měitiān duànliàn shēntǐ duì jiànkāng yǒu hǎochù.
column7: Exercising every day is good for your health.
column9: To exercise, to train: 鍛 "forge metal" plus 鍊 "refine". Both pieces come from metalworking, so the word means toughening your body or skills: 鍛鍊身體, 鍛鍊能力. The second syllable is a falling tone: liàn. More general than 健身.

column3: To win, to earn something abstract such as respect or praise: 赢 "win" plus 得 "get". The object is not a match but what you gain: 赢得尊重, 赢得信任, 赢得比赛 as well. Written and a little formal. 赢 has 贝 "money" because it was about winning profit.
column6: Tā yíngdé le dàjiā de zūnzhòng.
column7: He won everyone's respect.
column9: To win, to earn something abstract such as respect or praise: 贏 "win" plus 得 "get". The object is not a match but what you gain: 贏得尊重, 贏得信任, 贏得比賽 as well. Written and a little formal. 贏 has 貝 "money" because it was about winning profit.

column3: Literary "to obtain, to win", used mostly in compounds: 获得, 获奖, 获胜, 获取. Alone it takes an object like a prize: 获过很多奖. The 艹 on top is the grass radical;
column4: 这位科学家一生获过很多奖。
column5: 這位科學家一生獲過很多獎。
column6: Zhè wèi kēxuéjiā yīshēng huò guo hěn duō jiǎng.
column7: This scientist won many prizes in his life.
column9: Literary "to obtain, to win", used mostly in compounds: 獲得, 獲獎, 獲勝, 獲取. Alone it takes an object like a prize: 獲過很多獎. The 艹 on top is the grass radical;

column3: To win a prize: 获 "obtain" plus 奖 "prize". Verb-object, so you can split it: 获过奖, 获了一等奖. Also an attribute: 获奖作品 "prize-winning work", 获奖者 "winner".
column6: Tā de xiǎoshuō huòjiǎng le.
column7: His novel won a prize.
column9: To win a prize: 獲 "obtain" plus 獎 "prize". Verb-object, so you can split it: 獲過獎, 獲了一等獎. Also an attribute: 獲獎作品 "prize-winning work", 獲獎者 "winner".

column3: Prize, award: 一等奖 "first prize", 得奖 "win a prize", 奖金 "bonus". Also a verb: 奖励 "to reward". The measure word is 个 or 项.
column4: 这次比赛的奖是一台电脑。
column5: 這次比賽的獎是一台電腦。
column6: Zhè cì bǐsài de jiǎng shì yī tái diànnǎo.
column7: The prize for this contest is a computer.
column9: Prize, award: 一等獎 "first prize", 得獎 "win a prize", 獎金 "bonus". Also a verb: 獎勵 "to reward". The measure word is 個 or 項.

column3: Challenge, to challenge: 挑 "provoke" plus 战 "fight". It works as a noun (面对挑战, 一个挑战) and as a verb (挑战自己, 挑战世界纪录). 挑 is tiǎo here ("provoke"), not tiāo "to pick". 战 has 戈 "spear" for fighting.
column4: 学汉字对我是一个挑战。
column5: 學漢字對我是一個挑戰。
column6: Xué Hànzì duì wǒ shì yī ge tiǎozhàn.
column7: Learning Chinese characters is a challenge for me.
column9: Challenge, to challenge: 挑 "provoke" plus 戰 "fight". It works as a noun (面對挑戰, 一個挑戰) and as a verb (挑戰自己, 挑戰世界紀錄). 挑 is tiǎo here ("provoke"), not tiāo "to pick". 戰 has 戈 "spear" for fighting.

column3: To fail, to lose, failure: 失 "lose" plus 败 "be defeated". Use it for efforts, plans, experiments, teams: 实验失败了, 失败的原因. Opposite 成功. For a person who failed an exam, 没通过 or 不及格 are more precise. 败 has 贝 and 攵 "strike".
column6: Zhè cì shíyàn shībài le.
column7: This experiment failed.
column9: To fail, to lose, failure: 失 "lose" plus 敗 "be defeated". Use it for efforts, plans, experiments, teams: 實驗失敗了, 失敗的原因. Opposite 成功. For a person who failed an exam, 沒通過 or 不及格 are more precise. 敗 has 貝 and 攵 "strike".

column3: To strive, to struggle toward a goal: 奋 "exert" plus 斗 "fight". Used for long, hard effort for a dream or a better life: 为梦想奋斗, 努力奋斗. It carries admiration. Here 斗 is dòu "fight"; as a measure of grain it is dǒu. 奋 shows a person 大 in a field 田.
column6: Tā wèi mèngxiǎng fèndòu le shí nián.
column7: He has strived for his dream for ten years.
column9: To strive, to struggle toward a goal: 奮 "exert" plus 鬥 "fight". Used for long, hard effort for a dream or a better life: 為夢想奮鬥, 努力奮鬥. It carries admiration. Here 鬥 is dòu "fight"; as a measure of grain it is dǒu. 奮 shows a person 大 in a field 田.

column3: Fierce, intense: 激 "stir up" plus 烈 "strong". Before a noun or as predicate for contests, debates, fighting: 竞争激烈, 激烈的比赛, 比赛非常激烈. It is not for feelings of a person (that is 激动). 烈 has 灬 "fire" at the bottom.
column6: Bǐsài fēicháng jīliè.
column7: The match is very intense.
column9: Fierce, intense: 激 "stir up" plus 烈 "strong". Before a noun or as predicate for contests, debates, fighting: 競爭激烈, 激烈的比賽, 比賽非常激烈. It is not for feelings of a person (that is 激動). 烈 has 灬 "fire" at the bottom.

column3: Cartoon, animated film: 动画 "animation" plus 片 "film". The short form 动画 is common too. 片 here means a film. The short form 动画 is also used. 动 has 云 and 力: "move with strength".
column6: Háizimen dōu ài kàn dònghuàpiàn.
column7: All the children love watching cartoons.
column9: Cartoon, animated film: 動畫 "animation" plus 片 "film". The short form 動畫 is common too. 片 here means a film. The short form 動畫 is also used. 動 has 重 and 力: "move with strength".

column3: Role, character in a play, film or game: 角 "corner, role" plus 色 "kind". 扮演角色 or 演主要角色 "play the lead". It also means a part someone plays in real life: 在家庭中的角色. 角 is read jué here, not jiǎo "horn, corner".
column4: 他在电影里演主要角色。
column5: 他在電影裡演主要角色。
column6: Tā zài diànyǐng lǐ yǎn zhǔyào juésè.
column7: He plays the lead role in the film.
column9: Role, character in a play, film or game: 角 "corner, role" plus 色 "kind". 扮演角色 or 演主要角色 "play the lead". It also means a part someone plays in real life: 在家庭中的角色. 角 is read jué here, not jiǎo "horn, corner".

column3: Shape, design, look: 造 "make" plus 型 "mold". The form given to something by design: 造型独特, 发型造型, 动画造型. It suits objects, hair and people on stage. 型 has 土 "earth" for a clay mold and 刑 for sound.
column4: 这个杯子的造型很特别。
column5: 這個杯子的造型很特別。
column6: Zhège bēizi de zàoxíng hěn tèbié.
column7: The shape of this cup is very special.
column9: Shape, design, look: 造 "make" plus 型 "mold". The form given to something by design: 造型獨特, 髮型造型, 動畫造型. It suits objects, hair and people on stage. 型 has 土 "earth" for a clay mold and 刑 for sound.

column3: Pattern, design: 图 "picture" plus 案 "plan". The repeated design on cloth, wallpaper or porcelain: 花朵图案, 图案设计. Not a picture with meaning, just a decorative layout. 图 has 囗 "border" around an inner part.
column4: 这件衣服上有漂亮的图案。
column5: 這件衣服上有漂亮的圖案。
column6: Zhè jiàn yīfu shàng yǒu piàoliang de tú'àn.
column7: There is a pretty pattern on this garment.
column9: Pattern, design: 圖 "picture" plus 案 "plan". The repeated design on cloth, wallpaper or porcelain: 花朵圖案, 圖案設計. Not a picture with meaning, just a decorative layout. 圖 has 囗 "border" around an inner part.

column3: Color, but alone it is mostly a part of words: 红色, 颜色, 色彩, 特色. As a free word it needs a context such as 色很正 "the color is true". It can also mean "look, expression", as in 脸色. Do not use 色 alone for "color" in speech: say 颜色.
column6: Zhè kuài bù de sè hěn zhèng.
column7: The color of this cloth is very pure.
column9: Color, but alone it is mostly a part of words: 紅色, 顏色, 色彩, 特色. As a free word it needs a context such as 色很正 "the color is true". It can also mean "look, expression", as in 臉色. Do not use 色 alone for "color" in speech: say 顏色.

column3: Color, hue, flavor: 色 "color" plus 彩 "bright color". A more literary word than 颜色. Refers to the range of colors in art (色彩丰富) or to a quality such as 民族色彩 "ethnic flavor". 彩 has 彡 for brightness and 采 for sound.
column6: Zhè fú huà de sècǎi hěn fēngfù.
column7: The colors in this painting are very rich.
column9: Color, hue, flavor: 色 "color" plus 彩 "bright color". A more literary word than 顏色. Refers to the range of colors in art (色彩豐富) or to a quality such as 民族色彩 "ethnic flavor". 彩 has 彡 for brightness and 采 for sound.

column3: Colorful, of every color: 五 "five", 颜 "color", 六 "six", 色 "color". A four-character set phrase where the numbers just mean "many". Before a noun with 的: 五颜六色的花. Do not take 五 and 六 as exact counts.
column4: 花园里开着五颜六色的花。
column5: 花園裡開著五顏六色的花。
column6: Huāyuán lǐ kāizhe wǔyánliùsè de huā.
column7: Flowers of every color bloom in the garden.
column9: Colorful, of every color: 五 "five", 顏 "color", 六 "six", 色 "color". A four-character set phrase where the numbers just mean "many". Before a noun with 的: 五顏六色的花. Do not take 五 and 六 as exact counts.

column3: Model, mold: 模 "pattern" plus 型 "type, mold". A scaled copy of something or a pattern for making things: 飞机模型, 建筑模型. Also a mathematical or scientific model. 模 is read mó here; in 模样 it can be mú.
column6: Tā zuò le yī ge fēijī móxíng.
column7: He made a model aeroplane.
column9: Model, mold: 模 "pattern" plus 型 "type, mold". A scaled copy of something or a pattern for making things: 飛機模型, 建築模型. Also a mathematical or scientific model. 模 is read mó here; in 模樣 it can be mú.

column3: Style: 风 "wind, manner" plus 格 "pattern". The look or manner of a work, person or period: 写作风格, 她的穿衣风格, 中国风格. A person who dresses in a certain way has a 风格. 格 has 木 and 各 for sound.
column6: Tā xǐhuan jiǎndān de fēnggé.
column7: She likes a simple style.
column9: Style: 風 "wind, manner" plus 格 "pattern". The look or manner of a work, person or period: 寫作風格, 她的穿衣風格, 中國風格. A person who dresses in a certain way has a 風格. 格 has 木 and 各 for sound.

column3: Tide, and slangily "trendy": 涨潮 "high tide", 退潮 "low tide". Also "damp": 潮湿. In the sense of fashion, 很潮 means up to date. The radical 氵 shows water, and 朝 gives the sound cháo.
column6: Zhè jiàn yīfu hěn cháo.
column7: This piece of clothing is very trendy.
column9: Tide, and slangily "trendy": 漲潮 "high tide", 退潮 "low tide". Also "damp": 潮濕. In the sense of fashion, 很潮 means up to date. The radical 氵 shows water, and 朝 gives the sound cháo.

column3: Trend, tide of fashion: 潮 "tide" plus 流 "flow". The direction a society or fashion moves: 时代的潮流, 追随潮流 "follow the trend". It stresses a strong current that is hard to resist. Compare 趋势, which is a tendency.
column6: Niánqīngrén xǐhuan zhuīsuí cháoliú.
column7: Young people like to follow trends.
column9: Trend, tide of fashion: 潮 "tide" plus 流 "flow". The direction a society or fashion moves: 時代的潮流, 追隨潮流 "follow the trend". It stresses a strong current that is hard to resist. Compare 趨勢, which is a tendency.

column3: Climax, high point: 高 "high" plus 潮 "tide". The peak of a film, a story, a match or an event: 电影的高潮, 进入高潮. It is also the high tide of the sea in its literal sense. A word for a plot's most exciting part.
column6: Diànyǐng de gāocháo hěn jīngcǎi.
column7: The climax of the film is very exciting.
column9: Climax, high point: 高 "high" plus 潮 "tide". The peak of a film, a story, a match or an event: 電影的高潮, 進入高潮. It is also the high tide of the sea in its literal sense. A word for a plot's most exciting part.

column3: Handwork, handmade: 手 "hand" plus 工 "work". As an adjective before a noun: 手工蛋糕, 手工艺品. As a noun: 做手工 "do crafts", a favorite kids' activity. 工 is a picture of a worker's tool. Contrasts with 机器 "machine".
column6: Zhè shì shǒugōng zuò de dàngāo.
column7: This is a handmade cake.
column9: Handwork, handmade: 手 "hand" plus 工 "work". As an adjective before a noun: 手工蛋糕, 手工藝品. As a noun: 做手工 "do crafts", a favorite kids' activity. 工 is a picture of a worker's tool. Contrasts with 機器 "machine".

column3: In front, ahead: 前 "front" plus 头 "end". Spoken, with a neutral second syllable (qiántou). Used in directions and in time: 前头有人 "there are people ahead", 我走在前头. Its pair is 后头. The written form is 前面.
column6: Lù qiántou yǒu yī jiā shāngdiàn.
column7: There is a shop ahead on the road.
column9: In front, ahead: 前 "front" plus 頭 "end". Spoken, with a neutral second syllable (qiántou). Used in directions and in time: 前頭有人 "there are people ahead", 我走在前頭. Its pair is 後頭. The written form is 前面.

column3: Behind, at the back: 后 "back" plus 头 "end". Spoken, with a neutral second syllable (hòutou). Place: 站在我后头; time: "later, afterwards": 后头再说. The written form is 后面.
column6: Tā zhàn zài wǒ hòutou.
column7: He stands behind me.
